stories.title: Allahabad High Court orders relocation of Hathras victim’s family to Ghaziabad or Noida within three months
‘Resettle Hathras victim’s family in Noida or Ghaziabad’:Allahabad HC gives govt 3 months, warns against rigid stance
stories.summary: Allahabad High Court on Tuesday came down heavily on the Uttar Pradesh government over the rehabilitation of the Hathras victim's family. The court directed the state to settle the family in Ghaziabad or Noida within three months and provide them with necessary facilities. It also ordered the government to give one family member a government job in accordance with its July 2022 order. A bench of Justices Rajan Roy and Jaspreet Singh termed the state government's approach "obstinate" and quashed its 22 February, 2025 decision offering the family rehabilitation in Kasganj, Etah or Aligarh. The court noted that the decision did not address the family's request to be relocated to Ghaziabad or Gautam Buddh Nagar and said it could be treated as "no decision in the eyes of the law." The court has made the Additional Chief Secretary (Home) responsible for ensuring compliance and directed the official to file an affidavit. Failure to comply will require the official to appear personally before the court at the next hearing, scheduled for 30 November, 2026. Family sought relocation to Ghaziabad or Noida After the Hathras case, in July 2022, the family told the High Court that it did not feel safe in Hathras and wanted to settle in Noida. It had also demanded a government job in Noida for one of its members. Later, the family applied for rehabilitation in Ghaziabad or Noida. On 14 November, 2024, the High Court directed the family to submit a formal application before the District Magistrate of Hathras. The family applied for rehabilitation in Ghaziabad/Gautam Buddh Nagar on 2 December, 2024. However, on 22 February, 2025, the state government offered the option of rehabilitation only in Kasganj, Etah, and Aligarh. Victim's brother says, 'Government should comply with the order soon' The victim's brother said the High Court's order has given the family hope that they will finally be able to "breathe freely." He said nine members of the family are still living under suffocating circumstances. He urged the government to comply with the court's order at the earliest and relocate the family to Noida or Ghaziabad. "The atmosphere in the village and the surrounding area is very hostile. We no longer want to live here. We want to leave this place," he said. 3 accused acquitted 3 years ago, 1 sentenced to life imprisonment In the Hathras case, the SC/ST court delivered its verdict on 2 March, 2023. The court found only one of the four accused, Sandeep Sisodia, guilty, while acquitting the other three accused-Lawkush, Ramu alias Ramkumar, and Ravi alias Ravindra Singh. The court sentenced Sandeep to life imprisonment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder. The charge of gang rape was not proven against any of the four accused. Hathras case: The complete timeline from 2020 to present September 14, 2020: A case involving the rape of a Dalit woman came to light in a village in the Chandpa area of Hathras. September 26, 2020: Based on the victim's statement, the names of three more accused-Lavkush Singh, Ramu, and Ravi Singh-were added to the case. All four were arrested and sent to jail. Referred to Delhi for Treatment: In critical condition, the victim was admitted to Delhi's Safdarjung Hospital after being treated at Aligarh's J.N. Medical College. September 29, 2020: The victim died during treatment. Her body was brought to Hathras, and the police conducted the cremation that same night. The family alleged that the cremation was carried out without their permission. October 2020: The case gained momentum after the cremation, triggering protests across the country. The Uttar Pradesh government suspended five police personnel, including the then Superintendent of Police and Circle Officer. October 11, 2020: On the recommendation of the state government, the CBI took over the investigation into the case. CBI investigation: The investigating agency questioned several people, including the victim's family members and the families of the accused. The crime scene was inspected and also re-created. December 18, 2020: After an investigation lasting approximately 67 days, the CBI filed a chargesheet against all four accused. Several serious charges, including murder and gang rape, were invoked. CBI's claim: The investigating agency based its case on the statement given by the victim before her death and alleged in the chargesheet that she was murdered after being gang-raped. Court Verdict: The charges of gang rape and murder were not proven in the trial court. 2022: Citing security concerns, the victim's family sought rehabilitation outside Hathras, particularly in Noida. 2024: The High Court directed the family to submit a formal application for rehabilitation before the District Magistrate. The family requested that they be settled in Ghaziabad/Gautam Buddh Nagar. February 22, 2025: The state government offered the family the option of settling in Kasganj, Etah, or Aligarh. No decision was taken on the family's demand for Noida/Ghaziabad. August 25, 2026: The Allahabad High Court quashed the government's decision and ordered that the family be rehabilitated in Noida or Ghaziabad within three months. Court's Displeasure: The High Court described the government's approach as "unnecessary resistance" and an "obstinate attitude." Government Job: The court also directed compliance with its earlier order to provide a government job to one member of the family. Next Hearing: The next hearing in the case will be held on November 30, 2026.

stories.title: UP woman alleges threat from Khan Sir:Claims Faisal Khan had an affair with her friend, spent hours at her room in Patna
stories.summary: A young woman from Uttar Pradesh has once again levelled serious allegations against Khan Global Studies Director Faisal Khan, also known as Khan Sir. Expressing fear for her life from Khan Sir, the woman has pleaded with the police for protection. The victim held a press conference in Patna on Tuesday. During this, she accused Khan Sir of having an illicit relationship with her female friend. The woman stated: I have known about this since 2017. Khan Sir used to visit my friend's room in Patna and stay there for hours. When I opposed this, Khan Sir tried to frame me in a police case and also threatened to kill me. Application submitted on August 21 Prior to this, the young woman had submitted an application at the Pirbahore police station on August 21. In her application, the woman stated that she knows many secrets about Faizal Khan. For this reason, she fears for her life. Meanwhile, on Monday, she recorded her statement before a female police officer. After receiving the complaint, the police contacted the woman and recorded her statement. According to the police, the matter is being investigated by taking the woman's complaint seriously. The police are investigating the allegations made in the complaint and the facts related to it. Read what has been stated in the application submitted by the young woman I am a resident of UP. Currently, I live in Patna. I came to Patna to study in August 2016. At that time, I used to study from Faizal Khan alias Khan Sir in Palparani, Deoria, UP. I have a lot of confidential information about Faizal Khan. Faizal Khan is also aware of this. In such a situation, my life is in danger because he has been harassing me since December 2014. Even nowadays, he threatens me, saying that if I reveal any confidential information, he will have me killed. I request you to investigate the truth of the above-mentioned matters and kindly provide protection for my life from Faizal Khan. Police are investigating the matter Town DSP Rajesh Ranjan had stated that a complaint was received from a relative of the young woman. The young woman has mentioned Khan Sir starting coaching in the Naya Gaon area in 2017 and his visits to a female friend's place. Now know what Khan Sir's team has said Meanwhile, regarding this matter, Khan Sir's team has stated that they have no information about where or why the application being discussed was submitted. The team says that attempts are being made to frame Khan Sir from all sides. According to the team, the festival of Raksha Bandhan is approaching, and it is celebrated on a large scale every year. A large number of female students also participate in this event. In such a situation, it has been alleged that a conspiracy is being hatched to prevent female students from reaching the event and to tarnish Khan Sir's image. Khan Sir is on bail in the coaching dispute Currently, Khan Sir is out on bail. The matter is sub-judice in court. Recently, in connection with a coaching dispute, the police had registered a case against him at the Kadamkuan police station. He was accused of deliberately having his guards open fire with the intention of spreading panic.

stories.title: Stones pelted at Mumbai-Ahmedabad Vande Bharat near Surat:Anandiben Patel was on board, remained unharmed in executive coach
stories.summary: A stone-pelting incident has occurred near Surat on the Vande Bharat Express (Train Number 22961) travelling from Mumbai to Ahmedabad. After departing from Surat Railway Station, anti-social elements threw stones at the train while it was passing near Utran station. Uttar Pradesh Governor Anandiben Patel was also travelling on the train at the time of the incident. However, as she was in an executive coach, she remained completely safe, and no casualties occurred. The incident occurred between 6.30 pm and 6.45 pm on 22961 Vande Bharat Express between Utran and Kosad. Meanwhile, the Governor's office of UP posted on X: “Governor Smt. Anandiben Patel, while travelling today from Vapi to Ahmedabad aboard the Vande Bharat Express, met with film and television actor Mr Anang Desai and other co-passengers to engage in dialogue on the film industry and other topics. Administrator of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, Mr Praful Patel, was also present.” Glass cracked in standard coaches C-6 and C-10 As the Vande Bharat train was passing near Utran, stones were suddenly thrown from outside. The glass of standard chair car coaches C-6 and C-10 cracked, causing panic among the passengers. Amid reports of a VVIP passenger on board, news of the stone-pelting triggered a rush among the railway administration and security agencies. RPF detains intoxicated youth Officers from the Ankleshwar Railway Protection Force (RPF) immediately reached the spot and initiated an investigation. The RPF team apprehended a suspicious youth, aged around 30, from near the track. Initial investigation revealed that the detained youth was in an intoxicated state; however, the official process of identification and interrogation is underway. In-depth probe launched into the intent behind the attack Security agencies are currently interrogating the detained suspect in detail to ascertain whether the stone-pelting was carried out merely in a state of drunkenness or if there was any other conspiracy or intent behind it. Following this incident, the railway administration has stepped up patrolling around the Surat-Ahmedabad railway track and strengthened security measures. Interrogation of the suspicious youth Western Railway PRO Anubhav Saxena stated that after the train departed from Surat, information was received regarding stone-pelting on the Vande Bharat train near Utran Railway Station. Accordingly, the RPF was informed immediately. The inspector from Ankleshwar RPF promptly reached the scene. A suspicious youth has been apprehended from there, and further interrogation is ongoing.

stories.title: Mob pelts CO with stones, smashes constable’s head:4 police vehicles vandalised; dispute over installing Ambedkar statue in Budaun
stories.summary: A dispute broke out in Budaun on Tuesday at 7:30 PM over the installation of a statue of Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar. A mob pelted stones at the police, leaving several police personnel, including the CO, injured. During the incident, several police vehicles and an ambulance were also vandalised. The incident occurred in the Faizganj Behta police station area. The dispute in Raja ki Sikri village began over the installation of the statue on village society land. On Monday night, some people had attempted to install the statue on this land. On Tuesday morning, they alleged that the statue had been damaged. See photos- Upon receiving the information, the SDM and CO Bisauli, along with police forces from nearby stations, reached the spot. The police tried to reason with the crowd throughout the day, but the people remained adamant about installing the statue right there. Around 7:30 PM, the crowd suddenly turned violent and started pelting stones at the police. Several police personnel, including CO Anshuman Srivastava, sustained injuries in the incident. The police resorted to a lathi-charge to disperse the crowd. Despite this, the violent mob vandalized 4 police vehicles and an ambulance. As soon as the incident was reported, police forces from 10 stations, including Faizganj Behta, Bisauli, Bilsi, Wazirganj, and Islamnagar, along with the PAC, reached the spot. SSP Ankita Sharma also arrived at the scene. The police have taken 7 people into custody. The village has been blockaded, and efforts are underway to apprehend the attackers.

stories.title: Railway JE’s legs severed by train, dies:Went to inspect tracks in Agra; torso separated, remains conscious
stories.summary: A Railway JE died in agony following an accident in Agra on Wednesday evening. Both his legs were severed by a train. However, the blood-soaked JE lying by the side of the track did not lose consciousness. He kept staring blankly at the crowd gathered around him. Upon receiving information about the accident, the police took the JE to CHC Saiyan for treatment. Doctors referred the critically injured JE, Manoj Saini, to SN Hospital, where he passed away around 7 PM. He was checking the down track when he was hit by a passenger train coming from behind. The accident occurred near Saiyan town on the Agra-Jhansi railway track at 5:30 PM on Tuesday. 3 pictures of the accident JE Manoj was walking on the track Manoj Saini is posted as a Junior Engineer in the FMI department of the Railways. Around 5:30 PM, Manoj Saini got off the machine near Jajau railway station after taking a block. After this, he was walking on the down track. During this time, he was hit by a passenger train coming from the direction of Bhadai. He was seriously injured upon being hit by the train. Both his legs were severed. JE lay by the railway track for 5 minutes A video has also surfaced after the accident, in which he is seen lying by the side of the track after his legs were severed. Both his legs were lying on the track. He lay there for at least 5 minutes. He did not even realize what had happened. After this, fellow railway employees reached the spot. They also spoke to him for a while. The railway employees immediately informed the 112 police and 108 ambulance. Upon receiving the information, the Saiyan police station reached the spot with an ambulance and immediately took the injured Manoj Saini to CHC Saiyan. After receiving first aid at the CHC, doctors referred him to SN Hospital, Agra, given his critical condition. At SN Hospital, doctors began treating Manoj Saini, but his condition remained critical. He passed away during treatment around 7 PM. Upon receiving information about the incident, the police gathered details related to the case.

stories.title: UP YouTuber with 7 lakh followers dies in crash:Car rams into truck, mother also dies; family was travelling to Ujjain
stories.summary: Hathras YouTuber Chhavi Varshney (23) and her mother died in a road accident. Chhavi had left with her family by car late Monday night to visit the Mahakaleshwar Temple in Ujjain. On Tuesday morning, their car collided with a truck in Agar Malwa, Madhya Pradesh. There were a total of five people in the car. Chhavi and her mother died on the spot in the accident. Her father, a relative, and the driver were seriously injured. All three have been admitted to Barod District Hospital. Chhavi had more than 7 lakh followers on her YouTube channel. She created videos related to lifestyle and motivation. Shyamlal (54) runs a grocery store in Mahaukhas village in the Hathras Junction area. His family consists of his wife, Sarika (50), daughter Chhavi Varshney (23), and son, Kanha (26). On Monday night, Shyamlal, his daughter Chhavi, wife Sarika, relative Surajpal, and driver Sachin were traveling to Ujjain for a pilgrimage. At 6 a.m. on Tuesday, their car crashed into a truck traveling ahead near Ramakhedi village on the Ujjain-Garoth four-lane highway. The car was completely wrecked in the accident. As soon as they received information about the incident, ambulance pilots Sandeep Goswami and Amrish reached the spot. They pulled the injured passengers trapped inside the car out and took them to the Government Community Health Center in Barod for treatment. Sarika was severely trapped inside the car. It took considerable effort to rescue her. Driver lost control of the car Chhavi and her mother, Sarika, were brought to CHC Barod in an NHAI ambulance. At the community health center, Dr. Vijendra Chudihar declared the mother and daughter dead. Meanwhile, her father Shyamlal, father-in-law Surajpal, and driver Sachin were seriously injured. They were given first aid and referred to the district hospital. Barod police also reached the accident site and gathered information from people nearby. According to preliminary information, the Ertiga driver lost control of the car. The car collided with a truck traveling ahead. The accident caused chaos on the four-lane road for some time. Police have registered a case and begun an investigation. Started a YouTube channel 5 years ago Chhavi's cousin Sachin Varshney said, "She had been talented since childhood and completed her graduation. She always excelled in her studies as well. From the beginning, she was passionate about doing something different and moving ahead." In 2021, Chhavi started her own YouTube channel. Initially, she began creating vlogs and videos related to her daily life. Gradually, people began to like her videos, and the channel's popularity grew rapidly. After that, she also started creating online gaming videos. More than 700,000 followers on YouTube Chhavi's YouTube channel had more than 700,000

stories.title: How buses became the lifeline of Madras

stories.title: How bicycles, motorcycles took over the roads of Madras

And while cycles were riding onward, two-wheelers of the motor variety, not so quietly, took to the roads. Brands such as Royal Enfield even set up manufacturing units in the region. To this day, two-wheelers number among the most convenient ways for getting around in the city

stories.title: Hauling about the Madras city on trains
stories.summary: Madras was the first place in India where trains were introduced. In 1856, Royapuram became the terminus for a line that ran to Walajah Road. On the suburban side, the ball began rolling in the 1900s, and while the network grew, it never quite rivalled those in places such as Mumbai. Then came the MRTS, which never realised its full potential. At present, Metro Rail is the city’s latest attempt to get back on track

stories.title: SC says no donation theft at Banke Bihari Temple:Every penny must go into donation boxes; devotees’ offerings belong to the deity
stories.summary: Amid reports of theft of offerings at the Ram Mandir, the Supreme Court on Tuesday issued a major directive regarding donations received at Vrindavan's Banke Bihari Temple. The court said that every single penny donated at the temple must first be put into the donation box. Alternatively, the donation amount must be transferred directly to the temple's account through its official online payment system. "We will not allow offerings to be stolen," the court said. The Supreme Court said that no temple servitor, priest, or any other person associated with the temple can keep donation money with themselves. The court also made it clear that any donation made by a devotee is meant for the deity. The deity has the first right over it. Only after the money is deposited in the temple treasury can the servitors or other concerned persons receive their share. In fact, a video was presented before the bench comprising Chief Justice Suryakant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi, and Justice V. Mohana. It showed three people standing in front of the temple's donation box, collecting money from devotees and placing it in plastic bags. The Supreme Court issued this order thereafter. Court said immediate attention is needed The Supreme Court was hearing petitions concerning the management committee of the Shri Banke Bihari Maharaj Temple. Senior advocate Maninder Singh presented a status report of the high-powered committee regarding the alleged theft of donations at the temple. He also presented photographs and said that the situation was very serious. It requires immediate action. Taking the matter seriously, the court directed the temple management committee to ensure transparency and accountability in the entire donation process. The court instructed the committee to establish an appropriate system for this purpose. It said that a complete account of all donations received at the temple should be maintained, leaving no scope for any irregularity or misappropriation. Supreme Court warning: Do not conduct any transaction without our permission The Supreme Court also issued a stern warning to the servitors and other concerned individuals. It said that if anyone tries to prevent donations from reaching the temple treasury or creates any kind of obstruction in this system, it will be taken very seriously. If a proposal is made to purchase any property using temple funds, the Supreme Court must be informed. No transaction should be carried out without the Court's permission. Following the Supreme Court's order, committee chairman and retired judge Ashok Kumar said, "We want to establish a better and transparent system at the temple, but some people are obstructing it. Some people stand in front of the donation boxes and try to collect offerings from devotees. Moreover, the QR codes installed at the temple have also been scratched off." Donations worth ₹4.90 crore received from February to April A high-power committee meeting was held three months ago at the Shaheed Laxman Singh Memorial Building. Discussions were held on 29 points, including the temple's income, security and arrangements. The meeting was chaired by Ashok Kumar, a retired High Court judge and chairman of the committee. The committee had stated that devotees donated ₹4.90 crore in the temple's 18 donation boxes over the three months from February to April. This included 10 dollars from England, 333 dollars from the United States, 115 Canadian currency units, more than 600 UAE currency units and Nepali currency. All the foreign currency had been deposited in the bank.

stories.title: Free roadways bus travel for elderly women in UP:25 lakh students to get tablets; medical students’ allowance hiked by ₹13,000; know Yogi Cabinet decisions
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's Cabinet on Tuesday approved 24 proposals, with a focus on women, students and the youth. The key decisions include free lifetime travel on Roadways buses for women aged above 60, a hike in the internship stipend for MBBS and BDS students from ₹12,000 to ₹25,000 per month, and tablets for 25 lakh students. The Cabinet also approved the release of pending scholarships for 3.57 lakh SC, ST, OBC and minority students by reopening the scholarship portal and releasing the required funds. It also cleared the payment of pending honorariums to district coordinators, block coordinators and education motivators. Under the Lokmata Ahilyabai Matrushakti Yojana, around one crore women aged above 60 will be eligible for free lifetime travel on Roadways buses. They will be issued special smart cards. CM Yogi will launch the scheme himself at Lucknow's Indira Gandhi Pratishthan on Wednesday, while ministers in charge of various districts will oversee its rollout there. The government has also announced free travel for women on Roadways buses during Raksha Bandhan. The facility will be available from 6 a.m. on 27 August to midnight on 29 August. The Cabinet meeting, chaired by CM Yogi at around 6 p.m., approved 24 proposals. Transport Minister Dayashankar Singh and Finance Minister Suresh Khanna briefed the media on the decisions. Other key proposals... A portal will be opened for scholarships for Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), OBC, and minority students. Through this, scholarships will be given to 3.57 lakh students. The government will spend ₹551.95 crore on the scholarship. This scholarship will be provided to the students who were left out in the year 2025–26. The government has increased the stipend, or allowance, for medical internship from ₹12,000 to ₹25,000 per month. Prior to this, MBBS interns in UP were protesting to demand an increase in their stipend. The interns had demanded that the stipend be raised to ₹30,000 rupees per month. The students had also spoken to Deputy CM Brijesh Pathak regarding this issue. Officials had assured them that the proposal to increase the stipend would be placed before the Cabinet. A deadline of 7 September 2026 was set for this. Now, the Cabinet has approved increasing the stipend to ₹25,000 rupees per month. Ganga Expressway to extend up to Haridwar, ₹10,761 crore to be spent The Ganga Expressway will be extended from Prayagraj to Haridwar. An expenditure of ₹10,761 crore will be incurred on its extension. This will make connectivity from Bijnor to Haridwar easier. Apart from this, an Integrated Manufacturing and Logistics Cluster will be built in Sultanpur at a cost of ₹272 crore. This industrial cluster will be developed near the Purvanchal Expressway. The UP government will collect the revenue itself. The Uttarakhand government has agreed to the expansion, which will directly connect Bijnor and Haridwar. The extension will also make travel easier for pilgrims during the Prayagraj and Haridwar Kumbh events. The project will cost ₹10,761 crore. JPNIC given on a 30-year lease, two companies to run it jointly A major decision has been taken regarding the operation of the Jai Prakash Narayan International Centre (JPNIC) located in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow. The government has approved leasing the centre for 30 years to Vrindavan Bottlers Private Limited and Rockwood Hotel and Resort Private Limited. The operation of JPNIC will be carried out by private companies. The repair and necessary works of the centre will also be the responsibility of these companies. The construction of JPNIC, built on approximately 20 acres, was started in 2013 during the Samajwadi Party government. In 2017, before the completion of the work, construction was halted. By that time, around ₹850 crore had been spent. Now, preparations are underway to restart JPNIC, which has been lying closed for several years. What is the Lucknow Case? Ravi Kant Gupta has a house in Vikas Nagar, Lucknow. His 81-year-old mother had to leave the house and live in an old age home. It was alleged that her son did not allow his mother to stay in the house. Following this, Ravi Kant lodged a complaint with the administration to evict the son from the house. On 15 November 2022, the SDM ordered the removal of the son from the house. On 9 August 2023, the District Magistrate also upheld this order. Later, the Allahabad High Court quashed both orders. The High Court stated that under the 2007 law, authorities do not have the power to issue eviction orders. The matter reached the Supreme Court. The Supreme Court overturned the High Court’s decision. The court said that for the maintenance and protection of senior citizens, the tribunal can issue eviction orders. Textile park to be developed on PPP mode on Lucknow-Hardoi border A textile park will be built on the Lucknow-Hardoi border. This park will be built over 1,000 acres under the PM Mitra Scheme. The external development of the park will be carried out by the state government. A master developer will be selected for the internal development. The selected developer will handle internal development as well as the maintenance of the park for 50 years. A project worth ₹1,250 crore has been approved for facilities like roads, electricity, and water. Approximately ₹1,950 crore will be spent on this entire project. In the park, 55 per cent of the land will be for industrial use, 10 per cent for commercial use, and 10 per cent for residential use. Infrastructure facilities will be developed on the remaining 25 per cent of the land. The Cabinet has also approved the final bid document. Elderly parents will be able to disown children from property The Yogi government has approved an amendment to the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act. Now, parents will be able to disown children who do not take care of them from their property. This decision has come following a recent order by the Supreme Court. On 4 August 2026, in the case of Ravi Kant Gupta from Lucknow, the Supreme Court stated that tribunals can order the eviction of children from the property for the safety and maintenance of senior citizens.

stories.title: IPS Charu Nigam gets emotional after being transferred from Sultanpur:Says she was capable of handling district despite pregnancy
stories.summary: IPS officer Charu Nigam has expressed her disappointment after being removed as Sultanpur Superintendent of Police. On Monday, she posted an emotional message on X, saying that becoming a mother is not a weakness but a strength. While bidding farewell to Sultanpur, Nigam writes that despite being pregnant, she handled the responsibilities of the district with full capacity during her 197-day tenure. Her post reflects her disappointment over being removed from the SP post. A 2013-batch IPS officer, Nigam serves as Sultanpur SP from February 2024. On August 20, the state government transferred her to UP 112. During her tenure, large-scale police transfers and postings and her dispute with BJP MLC Devendra Singh remain in the headlines. Born in Delhi, family roots in Agra Charu Nigam is born in Delhi, while her family has roots in Agra. Her father, MS Nigam, moves to New Delhi after securing a job with the Delhi Development Authority. Charu completes her schooling in Delhi. She holds a B.Tech degree from IIT. Although she has the option of pursuing a comfortable corporate career, she begins preparing for the PCS examination on her father’s advice. Fails first attempt, father supports her Nigam appears for the 2010 Civil Services examination but does not clear it on her first attempt. During this difficult period, her father remains her biggest source of support. In an interview, she recalls that her father always supports her and helps her with her studies. She later clears the IPS examination after around six months of preparation. Nigam says she never puts excessive pressure on herself during studies. Known for her smile Nigam says laughing is like a hobby for her and that she is often reprimanded for laughing at school and college. Apart from this, she enjoys horse riding and cooking. She often cooks for her family during her free time. When a BJP leader reprimands her publicly In May 2017, Nigam is posted as a trainee IPS officer in Gorakhpur. At the time, current BJP MP Radha Mohan Das Agarwal is an MLA. Agarwal publicly reprimands Nigam over an alleged lathi-charge on women protesting against illicit liquor. He alleges that a pregnant woman and children are also injured during the incident. The incident takes place in the Chilua Taal police station area, where villagers protest against illicit liquor. A confrontation occurs between Nigam and the protesters while police attempt to clear a road blockade. Nigam later says her tears are not because of the reprimand but because of the support she receives from fellow IPS officers. She subsequently writes on social media that her tears should not be mistaken for weakness and that they emerge from tenderness rather than helplessness. Vineet Jaiswal becomes new Sultanpur SP Vineet Jaiswal is appointed as the new SP of Sultanpur. A 2014-batch IPS officer of the Uttar Pradesh cadre, Jaiswal is a native of Gorakhpur. His father, Radheshyam Jaiswal, retired as a Jail Superintendent. Vineet holds a B.Tech degree in Computer Science and worked as a software engineer at Infosys before joining the civil services.

stories.title: Councillors vow to share municipal earnings:Take water oath to divide money equally, make derogatory remarks about ‘traitors’
stories.summary: A video of several councillors from the Shahjahanpur Municipal Corporation has surfaced. In it, all the councillors seen appear to be taking an oath to divide the municipal corporation's income equally among themselves. In the video, one councillor can be seen holding water in his palm and administering the oath to the other councillors. During the oath-taking, an objectionable remark invoking the mother's name was also made about any councillor who betrayed the group. Most of the councillors seen in the video are reportedly associated with the BJP. One councillor recites the words of the oath, while the others appear to repeat them. The video is said to be around six months old but surfaced at 2 p.m. on Tuesday. However, Dainik Bhaskar does not verify the video. 2 pictures of the councillors taking the oath... The oath included a pledge to support one another In the video, the councillors can be heard saying that all income generated by the municipal corporation will be distributed equally among everyone. If any one councillor comes under scrutiny, they will all stand united in support of that councillor. After this, one councillor used an offensive, mother-related slur for anyone who betrays them. Some councillors can be seen throwing the water they held in their hands during the oath onto the ground, while others drank it. Mayor Denies Having Any Information Mayor Archana Verma denied having any information about the video. An attempt was made to contact the municipal commissioner, but the call was not answered. An attempt was also made to contact councillor Lalu Pujari, who is seen administering the oath in the video, but he did not answer the call. Congress demands action Congress district president Rajneesh Gupta, alias Munna, said, "Corruption in the municipal corporation is at its peak. The councillors had taken an oath after winning the election. Now, a different kind of oath is emerging in the video. Which oath is the real one? We will soon meet the officials and demand action in the matter." Meanwhile, SP district president Tanveer Khan said, "The municipal corporation is an institution connected with the public. The kind of things being said in the video will send a wrong message among the people. Such a situation should not arise." Shahjahanpur Municipal Corporation was formed in 2018 Shahjahanpur Municipal Board was declared a municipal corporation on 17 April 2018. In the 2023 municipal corporation elections, 41 BJP councilors were elected. Councilors from other parties also won the elections. Some councilors have also been nominated by the government. The Municipal Corporation Has Already Faced Corruption Allegations Construction company faced action over fake experience certificate An FIR was recently filed against Sunil Kumar Singh, the operator of Bhadoria Construction Company, over allegations of a fake experience certificate and a tender scam in the municipal corporation. The firm has been blacklisted in this case. Irregularities also came to light in outsourcing recruitment Irregularities had also come to light in the recruitment of employees through outsourcing. It is alleged that clerks and other employees posted in the corporation got their relatives and close associates appointed to the posts of sanitation workers. Several of these employees were also found to be drawing salaries without reporting for work. During the investigation, 22 such employees were identified whose appointments and attendance were questioned. Subsequently, the corporation stopped their salaries. The recruitment process and the employees' actual attendance are now also being investigated.

stories.title: After CM’s directive, FIRs filed against 7 firms, 2 arrested:₹100 crore tenders cancelled, kingpin Govind Sharma absconding; SIT formed to probe case
stories.summary: Following Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's directive, Kanpur's Municipal Commissioner took strong action and filed six separate FIRs against seven firms. Police have arrested two contractors involved in manipulating tenders, while the alleged kingpin, Govind Sharma, is absconding. His location has been traced to Rajasthan, and two teams are conducting raids to arrest him. Police Commissioner Raghuveer Lal provided information on Tuesday afternoon about the filing of the FIRs and the arrest of the two contractors. Municipal Commissioner Arpit Upadhyay said that tenders worth more than ₹100 crore had been cancelled following the registration of the FIRs. The Police Commissioner has formed an SIT to investigate corruption in the contracts. The mafias involved in the buying and selling of tenders will soon be arrested, and the entire syndicate will be exposed, the Commissioner said. Raghuveer Lal said that in the five FIRs registered at Swaroop Nagar police station, the Municipal Commissioner himself is the complainant, while the complainant in the FIR registered at Fazalganj police station is contractor Shani Singh. Police have arrested two contractors, Sandeep Jain and Rajjan Bajpai, in connection with the case and have begun an investigation. Shani Singh, who filed the report, said that mafia rule prevailed in the Kanpur Municipal Corporation, where tenders were withdrawn through intimidation and threats. An entire syndicate was operating in the municipal corporation. Only those favoured by the syndicate received tenders worth crores. The investigation so far has revealed that 427 firms are registered with the municipal corporation for various small and large projects. The responsibility for securing tenders for any firm lay with Agra-based contractor Govind Sharma. No one could get a contract without Govind's consent. Govind Sharma has also been named in the FIR. He fled the city after the Chief Minister took a tough stance. In view of corruption in the tender process, the Municipal Commissioner has cancelled tenders worth more than ₹100 crore.

stories.title: Mayawati announces BSP will contest Punjab polls alone:Says alliances cost votes and seats; people fed up with AAP, Congress and BJP
stories.summary: Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) chief Mayawati has made a major announcement regarding the Punjab Assembly elections. She said that the BSP will contest the elections in Punjab independently, without any alliance or arrangement. In the previous elections, the BSP had an alliance with the Shiromani Akali Dal. Mayawati said that alliances cause the party to suffer losses in both seats and vote share, and also affect the morale of party workers. On Tuesday, Mayawati held a lengthy meeting with Punjab party office-bearers at the BSP's central camp office in Lucknow to review the organisation and election preparations. 'Only hardworking and honest people will be given tickets' Mayawati said that preparations for the Assembly elections to be held next year in Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand, along with Punjab, would also be intensified. Hardworking and honest people will be given priority in the selection of candidates. She also reviewed the progress report on the earlier directives issued to strengthen the party organisation down to the booth level and expand its support base. She instructed that shortcomings identified at various levels be addressed within a set timeframe. Targeting AAP, Congress and BJP in Punjab The BSP chief also targeted the Congress and BJP, along with Punjab's ruling Aam Aadmi Party. She said that the attitude of these parties has left the people of the state distressed. Mayawati said that the BSP would present the people of Punjab with Ambedkarite policies and programmes based on the principles of "welfare and happiness for all." The party claims that this would help free Punjab from poverty and unemployment and provide people with a path to live with self-respect. Show of strength on October 9, the death anniversary of Kanshi Ram Mayawati directed party workers to ensure the success of the programme to be held on October 9 to mark the death anniversary of party founder Kanshi Ram, with thorough preparations. She said that preparations for the programme in Punjab should be made according to the guidelines issued last year. Emphasis was also placed on strengthening the organisation through this event. Directive to observe 'Public Welfare Day' on January 15, 2027 Mayawati also set a target of improving the party's financial contributions on the occasion of Public Welfare Day on January 15, 2027, compared with last year. She said that increasing BSP's financial contributions is essential to advancing the Ambedkarite caravan and the BSP movement. 'Firmly confront opponents' tactics of conciliation, inducement, coercion and division' Mayawati told party workers that they would have to firmly confront the tactics of saam, daam, dand and bhed (conciliation, inducement, coercion and division) used by opposition parties during the elections. The party must remain active up to the booth level and continue preparing consistently for better electoral results. She clarified that, like in Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand, the BSP will contest the elections in Punjab on its own.

stories.title: Police stop saints’ meeting against Champat Rai:Allegedly evicted from ashram and locked out; angry saints raise ‘donation thief’ slogans
stories.summary: On Tuesday, near Kar Sevakpuram in Ayodhya, the police stopped a meeting of saints at Om Ashram regarding the theft of offerings made to the Ram Mandir and against Champat Rai. The saints alleged that the police arrived in the middle of the meeting, forced them out of the ashram, and locked it. Angered by this, the saints raised slogans of "Chanda thieves, leave Ayodhya." However, the police said that the saints had left the ashram on their own before they could be stopped and had begun raising slogans. The saints said- Action has been taken against the minor accused in the donation theft, while the major accused are being protected. The district administration is supporting the accused. It does not want the accused to be arrested. That is why the saints' meeting is not being allowed to take place. Saints said: ‘The police did not explain why they stopped the meeting’ The meeting had been called by Prakashanand Giri, also known as Computer Baba. Mahant Janmejaya Sharan of Mahant Jankighat Bada Sthan, Mahamandaleshwar Parmanand Giri, Mahant Dilip Das, and eight-ten other saints had arrived. The saints said that when they asked the police why the meeting had been stopped, the police gave no reason. Some saints were not even allowed to attend the meeting. They were placed under house arrest. Computer Baba says a major movement will be launched to investigate the theft of offerings Computer Baba said that the saint community would launch a major movement demanding an impartial investigation into the theft of offerings and action against those responsible. If necessary, they will reach Ayodhya with one lakh saints and launch a movement. The saints will seek Lord Ramlala's darshan and ask Lord Shri Ram for forgiveness. Saints say they failed to stop the theft and seek forgiveness from Ram Lalla Mahant Mandaleshwar Parmanand Giri said, "The saints could not prevent this theft, and we fold our hands before Ram Lalla and apologise. Strict action should be taken against the accused, and the NSA should be invoked against them. The investigation should also reach those who played a major role in the theft of offerings." People from across the country have donated to the Ram Temple. All the saints are united on this issue. We will hold a meeting soon. All the saints of Ayodhya have been invited to the meeting. After the meeting, a memorandum will be submitted to the Chief Minister demanding a CBI investigation into the matter. Champat Rai's name not included in SIT's final investigation report The SIT formed by the Uttar Pradesh government to investigate the theft of offerings at the Ram Temple in Ayodhya has submitted its final report. According to sources, it does not mention former trust general secretary Champat Rai or member Dr. Anil Mishra. The remaining eight accused are already in jail. The Uttar Pradesh Home Department submitted the report to Mahant Nritya Gopal Das, president of the Ram Temple Trust. It will be presented at the Ram Temple Trust meeting scheduled for September 2. The trust itself had requested the Uttar Pradesh government to conduct an SIT investigation into the theft of offerings. The UP government formed a three-member SIT on June 13 under the chairmanship of Lucknow Divisional Commissioner Vijay Vishwas Pant. IG Range Kiran S and Special Secretary in the Finance Department Neel Ratan Kumar were its members. The SIT submitted its preliminary report on 23 June. After this, the Supreme Court directed that the SIT investigation be handed over to an IPS officer and that a finance expert be included. A new SIT was formed on July 20, comprising Lucknow Range IG Kiran S, Ayodhya DIG Somen Verma, and Ayodhya SSP Gaurav Grover. This SIT is still investigating the theft of offerings. SIT submitted its preliminary report on June 23; 8 arrested two days later The case of theft first came to light on 7 June. The Uttar Pradesh government's SIT submitted its preliminary report to Additional Chief Secretary (Home) Sanjay Prasad on 23 June. An FIR was registered on June 25 based on a complaint by trust member Krishna Mohan. Ramshankar Yadav alias Tinnu and seven others were named in it. However, the names of senior officials, including Champat Rai and Dr. Anil Mishra, were not included. Within a few hours of the FIR being registered, the police arrested all eight accused, including Tinnu. Currently, they are all lodged in Faizabad jail. They have been accused of stealing currency notes and jewelry while counting offerings. Following the SIT's preliminary report, General Secretary Champat Rai and trustee Dr. Anil Mishra resigned, taking moral responsibility. The trust accepted both resignations and removed Gopal Nagarkatte from the list of special invitees. The Supreme Court had ordered the formation of a second SIT Four separate petitions related to the donation theft case have been filed in the Supreme Court. In addition to handing over the investigation to the CBI, the petitions seek the formation of an expert committee to review various issues related to the management of donations at the temple. The previous SIT was submitting reports at the state government level, whereas the new SIT will periodically submit status reports directly to the Supreme Court. The Supreme Court itself is monitoring the investigation into the entire matter. The Supreme Court had observed that police officers play a direct and more effective role in criminal investigations and the technical investigation of theft cases. Therefore, with the DIG and SSP included as members, the responsibility for the investigation has been assigned directly to officers of the police department.

stories.title: Husband, wife die as wall collapses in Varanasi:Bihar couple lived on rent in industrial area, slept under plastic sheet
stories.summary: Five people died in separate accidents amid continuous rain in Varanasi. Two people were injured. In the Manduadih area, a husband and wife died after a house wall collapsed following the rain. The couple, trapped under the debris, succumbed to their injuries. In Sir Govardhan, Lanka, a husband and wife were injured when a mud house collapsed. Both have been admitted to the trauma center. Details of the matter Ravindranath Mishra (60), originally from Dumariya in Jharkhand, lived with his wife Pratima (55) in a rented old house in the Bata More Industrial Area under the Manduadih police station limits. The couple had two sons. One son, Sudhir, lives in Munger, Bihar. Their younger son, Anand, lived with them. He ran a bati-chokha stall on Chandpur Road. On Monday night, the husband and wife were sleeping together. Their son Anand had gone to sleep at his uncle's house nearby. On Tuesday morning, after the rain, their old house collapsed. The wall of the house fell, burying the couple under the debris. According to local residents, the couple usually slept on the roof, but because of the rain on Monday night, they decided to sleep on their cart in the open, covered with plastic sheeting. As soon as the incident was reported, the station house officer of Manduadih reached the spot with a police team. Mud house collapses in Sir Govardhan, couple injured Nirmala and Ramji were injured after a mud house collapsed in Sir Govardhan, under the jurisdiction of Lanka police station. Both were pulled out from the debris and admitted to the trauma center for treatment. A goat tied inside the house died in the accident, while pet dogs are also reported to be trapped under the debris. Police and local residents are engaged in relief and rescue operations. Waterlogging at several places in the city Due to continuous rain, the waterlogging situation has become severe in several areas of Varanasi. Water reportedly reached waist level in the premises of Sir Sunderlal Hospital, while knee-deep water has also accumulated at Lanka Crossing. Several major roads and low-lying areas of the city are inundated. Continuous rainfall is worsening people's difficulties. stories.title: SP workers distribute ‘PDA sugar’ in Lucknow:Protest rising sugar prices; say E20 policy sent prices soaring
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party protest in Lucknow on Tuesday. Expressed resentment by distributing free PDA sugar. SP workers brought 1 kg packets of sugar and started distributing them while sitting between Bapu Bhawan and the Vidhan Sabha. During this, the protesters were chanting slogans, "Ever since the BJP has come, inflation has broken our backs." Sugar distributed to passersby At the intersection, SP workers spread out a sack, placed packets of sugar on it, and were calling out, "Come, take PDS sugar." People were getting off their vehicles to take the sugar packets, and during this, the workers were also going up to some passersby to give them packets of sugar. Along with this, they were telling the public that the prices of sugar are continuously skyrocketing under the current government. 'Sugar has become expensive due to E20' Protester Ramprakash Maurya said that in these times of inflation, we are spreading love. We are distributing PDA sugar. Sugar has reached ₹75 per kg, and its prices are touching the sky. We want the prices to decrease so that it reaches the common people. Sugar is becoming expensive due to E20; sugar is being mixed into petrol, and it is being sold to the common public at a high price. As long as E20 is not stopped, sugar will continue to get expensive. Rakshabandhan is a festival that comes once a year, and inflation is at its peak. Under the BJP government, food items have become so expensive that the common man's kitchen budget has been disrupted. The Samajwadi Party is continuously fighting against inflation and will continue to do so in the future.

stories.title: Dumper-Alto crash kills four:Accident while taking U-turn; bodies pulled out by breaking car doors, 6-year-old girl injured
stories.summary: Four people, including a husband, his wife, and their two children, were killed when a dumper truck collided with an Alto car in Barabanki on Tuesday morning. A 6-year-old girl was critically injured. The accident caused panic at the scene. Local residents rushed to the spot and informed the police. They broke open the car doors to rescue those trapped inside. According to eyewitnesses, around 11:30 AM, the occupants of the Alto had stopped on the side of the road to ask for directions. As soon as they started taking a U-turn, a dumper loaded with sand hit them hard. The collision was so severe that the Alto was crushed by a foot on one side. The dumper driver fled the scene after the accident. The police reached the spot, took possession of the bodies, and sent them for post-mortem. The deceased included 2 men, one woman, and a 12-year-old girl. The accident occurred near Bindora intersection under the Masauli police station area on the Bahraich highway. The dumper was heading from Lucknow towards Ramnagar, while the car (UP32CD0221) occupants were going towards Bahraich. Pictures of the accident- They had gone to Lucknow from Bahraich to get medicine According to the locals, there were a total of 5 people in the car. They had gone to Lucknow from Bahraich to get medicine. While returning, they lost their way and were trying to turn the car in front of Royal Dhaba near Bhul-Bhulaiya village when the accident occurred.

stories.title: 1 lakh youths to get govt jobs in 6 months:Yogi’s big announcement; joining letters handed to 3,572 candidates
stories.summary: One lakh young people will get government jobs within six months in UP. CM Yogi announced this in Lucknow on Tuesday. He said, “I will distribute joining letters to 1 lakh young people over the next six months.” In the last nine years, 9.30 lakh young people have been given government jobs. Their energy and talent have contributed to the state’s economic growth. Yogi directed recruitment commissions and boards to speed up the hiring process. He instructed them to issue recruitment s within one month of receiving details of vacant posts, conduct the examination within the next two months, and declare the results within one month. This means young people should receive their appointment letters within six months. The CM also distributed joining letters to 3,572 candidates from the Agriculture Department at Indira Gandhi Pratishthan. These included 3,446 Technical Assistants (Group C) and 126 Mandi Secretaries from the Mandi Parishad. Of the total candidates, 689 were women. CM Yogi's 5 big statements 1- Commissions should complete recruitment in 6 months Yogi told the commissions and recruitment boards to expedite the recruitment process. He directed that the recruitment should be issued within one month of receiving information about the posts. The examination should be held in the next two months, and the results should be declared within one month, i.e, the youth should receive their appointment letters within six months. Yogi cited the example of the UP Board examination system. He said - Earlier, it used to take three months to conduct board exams and another three months for the results to be declared. Now, a system has been put in place to conduct exams for 5.6 million candidates in 14 days and declare the results in the next 14 days. Higher education institutions and universities have also been asked to make the examination and result process simple and transparent. No shortage of sugar, 122 sugar mills are operational The Chief Minister said that there is no shortage of sugar in the state. During the previous government, 29 sugar mills were closed. 21 mills were sold at throwaway prices. In contrast, 122 sugar mills are operational under the current government. So far, about ₹3.25 lakh crore has been paid to sugarcane farmers. Before 2017, farmers had to struggle with electricity problems. Now, farmers in UP are being provided with about 10 hours of electricity. The government is also bearing the burden of electricity bills for about 1.6 million private tube wells. Earlier, farmers had to pay about ₹3 thousand crore for this. Japan, Germany, and Israel want to provide jobs to the youth of UP Yogi said that providing employment to the youth has helped in tripling UP's economy and increasing the per capita income of the people. Now, the demand for UP's youth is increasing abroad as well. A large delegation from Japan recently visited UP and expressed their desire to provide employment to the youth here in Japan. Germany and Israel are also offering employment opportunities to the youth of UP. According to the Chief Minister, 5,000 youth from UP are working in Israel. Newly appointed technical assistants should provide information about modern farming to farmers Yogi told the new agricultural technical assistants that their responsibility is not limited to government office work. They must take new farming techniques to the farmers' fields. They will have to provide information to farmers about drip irrigation, sprinklers, modern farming, crop rotation, and ways to increase income from crops. The CM said that agricultural scientists and technical assistants should work directly with farmers in the fields under 'Lab to Land'. The state's agricultural economy will only grow by working while keeping the respect and needs of the farmers in mind.

stories.title: Steering wheel pierces doctor’s chest, dies in agony:Car hits railing in Sultanpur while he was heading for surgery; 2 fellow doctors injured
stories.summary: A 34-year-old doctor died in a road accident in Sultanpur. The car, traveling at a speed of 100 km/h, collided with the bridge railing. The steering wheel pierced the doctor's chest. He succumbed to his injuries while struggling in his seat. Two other doctors sitting in the back seat of the car were injured. The condition of one is critical. The three doctors were on their way to perform surgery on a patient in the city. The accident occurred at 11:30 PM on Monday near the Dariyapur railway overbridge on the Prayagraj-Ayodhya highway while attempting to overtake another vehicle. The deceased, Dr. Akhtar, was a resident of Loharmau in Kanpur Dehat. Dr. Shailendra Jaiswal and Dr. Rashid sustained serious injuries. Both are residents of Sultanpur. Dr. Rashid's condition is critical, and he has been referred to Lucknow. Surgeon Dr. Shailendra is undergoing treatment at the district hospital. Now understand the entire matter in a chronological manner- Wife and children inconsolable Hamza, who worked at the hospital, wept bitterly upon seeing the body of the late Dr. Akhtar. He said, "A shopkeeper called us at night to inform us. We rushed to the district hospital, but by then, the doctor had already passed away." Dr. Akhtar's wife, Umme Ruman, and his two daughters, Arfa and Afiya, along with his son Khalid, are inconsolable.

stories.title: VIDEO| Expired chocolates looted in Kanpur:People took sacks and cartons; truckload of stock cleared in 30 minutes
stories.summary: A scramble broke out in Kanpur to loot expired chocolates and candies lying in a garbage dump. People on bikes and in cars parked their vehicles on the roadside and started gathering the chocolates and candies. A video of this incident is going viral on social media. The police and the Food Safety Department team have started an investigation into the matter. The video shows boxes of candies and chocolates lying in a pile of garbage. Some people are seen filling sacks with boxes of chocolates. Soon, a crowd gathers. A race ensues among bike riders to grab the chocolates. Girls and women started taking away bags full of chocolates. People began rushing to grab as many boxes as they could. Some carried them in bags, while others took away entire cardboard boxes. Truck and car drivers also stopped their vehicles and started picking up the chocolates. This caused a long traffic jam on the road. Within 30 minutes, the entire stock was cleared. The video is said to be from the garbage dumping yard located in the Panki Industrial Area. See 5 photos... Police are investigating when the video was recorded Initial police investigation revealed that the video is from the roadside behind the Fertilizer Factory, between LML intersection and Thums Up intersection. A company had dumped a large quantity of expired toffees and chocolate boxes in the open. As soon as the local people got the news of toffee and chocolate boxes lying on the side of the highway, a crowd gathered at the spot. During this, a passerby made a video and posted it on social media. During the investigation, the police found some torn and mud-stained empty wrappers of toffees at the spot, on which 'N' and 'Gujarat' are visible. The police are currently trying to find out when this video was recorded and which company or distributor dumped the goods so carelessly on the side of the highway. Expired toffees and chocolates are not good for health Doctors say that expired toffees and chocolates are not good for health. The milk, fat, and other ingredients present in them have already spoiled. This increases the risk of dangerous bacteria and fungus growing. Consuming them can lead to serious problems like food poisoning, severe stomach pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and acidity. Apart from this, complaints of allergies, rashes, and headaches can also occur. Due to children having weaker immunity, the effect on them can be even more severe. DCP West Kasim Abidi said- The video of the expired chocolate has come to our notice. The Panki police station in-charge has been ordered to investigate. Consuming such expired food items can pose a health risk to anyone; an FIR will be registered in the matter after the investigation.

stories.title: IAS Durga Nagpal makes clarification after HC rap:Accused of threatening judge; says, 'Did not speak improperly to him'
stories.summary: UP woman IAS officer Durga Shakti Nagpal has clarified the allegations made by a civil judge. On Tuesday, she stated that her only intention was to ensure proper representation in an old pending case related to government land. She did not exert any pressure. During the conversation, there was no discussion regarding the verdict or merits of the case, nor was any specific case name or number mentioned. Actually, on 4 August, Shabeena Khan, a Senior Division Civil Judge in Gonda district, wrote a letter to the District Judge against the IAS officer, stating that the Commissioner is misusing her position. She alleged that the officer exerted undue pressure on her, threatened to complain to the High Court, and questioned her upbringing, which has hurt her. In the letter, the judge provided full details of the call received from the woman IAS officer. She requested that the concerned case be transferred to another court. Following this, the case was transferred to the court of Naveen, the Senior Division Civil Judge FTC in Gonda. The Lucknow bench of the Allahabad High Court has also taken cognizance of this matter. In an order uploaded on the court's website on Monday, the bench stated that an IAS officer attempting to exert pressure by calling a judge is a direct attack on the independence of the judiciary. Criminal contempt proceedings should be initiated for this action. Accusation of exerting pressure in a 30-year-old case The entire matter is related to the 'Jyoti Vidya Mandir vs. Municipality' case, which has been pending in the lower court for about 30 years. Due to the case being quite old, the court was hearing it on an expedited basis. The matter is nearing resolution. It is alleged that Commissioner Durga Shakti Nagpal was exerting pressure on the Civil Judge in connection with this very case. Now read what explanation the Commissioner gave Understand the sequence of events described by the Civil Judge in the letter 'I will get the case transferred', raised questions on upbringing The Civil Judge wrote in the letter that when she tried to explain her point to the Commissioner, she refused to listen. The Commissioner said, "You did not even give me a chance to speak. You are not receiving my calls. I am wondering what kind of upbringing you have." To this, Civil Judge Shabina Khan replied that she is not obligated to disclose the duration or timing of her leave. Nor can she discuss a case over a fake call or from an unknown number. She clarified that government lawyers are present in court to represent the government's side. Despite this, the Commissioner expressed her anger, citing her position as a senior IAS officer. She said, "I will get the case transferred to the High Court." The judge agreed that she could certainly get the case transferred. Demand to transfer the case to another court accepted In a letter written to the District Judge, Civil Judge Shabina Khan has stated that the Commissioner misused the influence of his position. He attempted to exert undue pressure on her by threatening to file a complaint in the High Court. In the interest of fair justice, she has requested that the case pending in her court be transferred to another court. Her request has been accepted. Contempt proceedings may be initiated against the Commissioner... The Lucknow bench of the High Court has taken the allegations against the IAS officer seriously. Justice Syed Qamar Hasan Rizvi made a stern remark, stating that this is akin to obstructing the work of justice. He directed that the file be sent to the Chief Justice to initiate criminal contempt proceedings against the IAS officer, so that it can be decided which bench will hear the case.

stories.title: Gangster arrested after Gorakhpur police encounter:Shot in leg; used gang to rob locked houses
stories.summary: The police arrested a notorious thief in an encounter late Monday around 1 AM in the Ramgarhtal area of Gorakhpur. During the police action, the accused sustained a gunshot wound to his left leg. According to the police, the notorious thief has 25 cases registered against him, including under the Gangster Act, in Gorakhpur and Sant Kabir Nagar. He has been identified as Mohammad Shahjade, a resident of New Masjid, Turkmanpur, Rajghat. During interrogation, Shahjade revealed that he committed theft along with his accomplice Niyaz Ahmed and another associate. Based on the interrogation, the police are making efforts to arrest the other accused. The police have admitted Md. Shahjade to the district hospital, where he is undergoing treatment. From his possession, the police have recovered 4 stolen bangles, 1 ring, 1 mangalsutra, a necklace, ₹10,000 in stolen cash, a motorcycle, a country-made pistol, and live cartridges. Fired at police during checking In this regard, SP City Nimish Patil stated that the police were conducting checks in the Ramgarhtal area late at night based on a tip-off from an informant. At that moment, they signaled a bike rider to stop. Seeing the police, the bike rider started to flee. When the police chased him, he opened fire. During the retaliatory action by the police, the cunning thief was shot in the leg. Meanwhile, Constable Rampukar was also injured in the incident. He was also taken to the hospital for treatment. On 20 August, a theft incident occurred at a house in the Ramgarhtal police station area. CCTV footage of this incident was obtained, in which the thieves were seen committing the theft. One of them was identified as Md. Shahzade. Since then, the police have been searching for him.

stories.title: Ravi Kishan receives 'Sarvottam Nagrik Samman 2026':Says, 'It’s a proud moment'; gets emotional on stage
stories.summary: Gorakhpur Sadar MP and film actor Ravi Kishan has been honored with the 'Sarvottam Nagrik Samman 2026' for his contribution to art, Indian cinema, and public life. This honor was presented by the Meghashrey Foundation. Several prominent personalities who have contributed to various fields in the country were also honored at the ceremony held in Mumbai. Award for contribution to Art and Public Service Ravi Kishan was given this honor for his long-standing contribution to the field of Indian cinema and art, for bringing national recognition to regional cinema, and for his role in public life as a Member of Parliament. Along with acting, Ravi Kishan has also been active in the fields of politics and public service for many years. Meghashrey Foundation founder and social worker Seema Singh initiated this award with the objective of honoring those who have inspired society and the nation through their remarkable work in their respective fields. Many prominent personalities were present at the ceremony The award ceremony held in Mumbai was attended by the Governor of Maharashtra, Jishnu Dev Varma, Maharashtra's Minister of Cultural Affairs, Ashish Shelar, Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh's Akhil Bharatiya Sampark Pramukh, Ramlal, and Meghashrey Foundation founder, Seema Singh. It was in their presence that the award was presented to Ravi Kishan. Several distinguished individuals associated with science, art, culture, cinema, and social service were also honored at the ceremony. Many personalities, including Yogendra Yadav and Subhash Ghai honored Several prominent figures, including Param Vir Chakra awardee Honorary Captain Yogendra Singh Yadav, Padma Bhushan Prof. J. B. Joshi, Padma Shri Ashok Saraf, and filmmaker Subhash Ghai, were honored at the event. These personalities have made remarkable contributions in their respective fields. Their work and achievements were also appreciated during the ceremony. Ravi Kishan gets emotional upon receiving the honor After receiving the honor, MP Ravi Kishan Shukla said that receiving the 'Sarvottam Nagrik Samman 2026' from the Meghashrey Foundation is a moment of pride and emotion for him. He said that this honor will provide new energy and inspiration to his journey in art and public life so far. Ravi Kishan said that for him, this honor is not just an award, but a resolve to fulfill his responsibilities towards art, culture, and public service with even greater dedication. Created a distinct identity from cinema to politics Ravi Kishan started his acting career with Bhojpuri cinema and created a distinct identity for himself. After this, he also worked in films of many languages, including Hindi. His name is counted among the prominent artists who brought recognition to regional cinema across the country. After acting, he stepped into politics and also served as a Lok Sabha Member of Parliament. In recognition of his multifaceted contribution to art and public life, he was awarded the 'Best Citizen Award 2026'.

stories.title: ‘Hijab not essential part of Islamic faith’:Allahabad HC rejects student’s plea to wear headscarf in school
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court has refused to allow students to wear hijab in schools. The court said on Monday that following the school uniform rules is mandatory. It helps promote a sense of equality among children and also gives the school its own identity. The High Court said uniforms help maintain an environment free from religious discrimination. Therefore, no student can insist on changing the dress code prescribed by the school. The court stated- Permission to wear a hijab on an individual basis cannot be granted. This would be against the very concept of a uniform. It would shift the authority to determine school discipline from the institution to individual students. A division bench of Justice JJ Munir and Justice Inderjeet Singh made these remarks while dismissing the petition of a minor student, Sukaina Rizvi, who had sought permission to attend classes wearing a hijab along with the school's prescribed dress code. We will explain the entire case in detail, but first, under Bhaskar Knowledge, let’s understand where the school hijab controversy began, what the Supreme Court ruled, and what Islamic scriptures say about the hijab. Hijab controversy in schools began in Karnataka The hijab controversy in Karnataka began in January 2022 at a government college in Udupi. Some Muslim students demanded permission to attend classes wearing hijab, while the college administration said it violated the uniform rules. The protests then spread to other colleges, with counter-protests in some places involving students wearing saffron shawls. On 15 March 2022, the Karnataka High Court dismissed the students’ petitions, ruling that wearing the hijab was not an essential religious practice of Islam and that schools could enforce their prescribed dress code. Article 25: It guarantees freedom to profess and practise religion, but this right is not absolute. Article 19: It guarantees freedom of expression. Clothing can also be claimed as a form of expression, but reasonable restrictions can be imposed on this right. Hijab case still pending before Supreme Court On 13 October 2022, a two-judge Supreme Court bench delivered a split verdict on the hijab controversy, with the two judges taking different views. Justice Hemant Gupta upheld the Karnataka High Court’s decision. He said the school dress code applied equally to all students and that wearing the hijab had not been established as an essential religious practice of Islam. Justice Sudhanshu Dhulia, however, said it was not necessary to decide whether the hijab was an essential religious practice in this case. He said a student’s faith and choice should be considered under Articles 19 and 25. Where does the concept of hijab come from in Islam? The Quran contains key references to women’s clothing and modesty in Surah An-Nur, verse 31, and Surah Al-Ahzab, verse 59. Surah An-Nur 24:31: Women are instructed to lower their gaze, guard their chastity, and not display their adornments. The verse also mentions drawing their khumur (head coverings) over their chests. What does the Quran say is the reason behind this? 1. Identity and protection Surah Al-Ahzab 33:59 says that women should draw their outer garments over themselves so that they may be recognised and not harassed. 2. Respect for privacy Surah Al-Ahzab 33:53 instructs people to speak to or ask something of the Prophet’s wives from behind a screen. The verse describes this as better for the purity of heart. 3. Rules are not only for women Surah An-Nur 24:30 first instructs men to lower their gaze and guard their chastity. Court said: Only school administration has the complete right to decide dress code The court stated that as long as the school's dress code is uniform for all children, is framed with the right intent, and does not discriminate against anyone, the school administration has the absolute right to decide what the dress will be. Even if the school had previously allowed the wearing of a scarf (hijab), it does not mean that this has become a permanent right for the students forever. The school administration is free to change its rules. It is not compelled to continue with old exemptions. Court stated: Wearing hijab is not an essential part of the Islamic religion The court stated: Wherever this issue has been raised, the High Court's opinion has been consistent that wearing a headscarf (hijab) for women is not an essential part of the Islamic religion. It is not as if the religion would be in danger without it, or that a woman would be excluded from the religion if she does not wear it. No facts or evidence have been presented to prove this either. Court said - No ban on faith, expecting compliance with rules In its verdict, the Allahabad High Court referred to an old judgment of the Kerala, Bombay, and Karnataka High Courts. In the case of 'Fatima Tasneem vs State of Kerala', the court had stated that while on one hand, a student has the right to wear clothes of their choice, on the other hand, a school or institution has the right to enforce its own rules and regulations. When there is a conflict or dispute between these two rights, the larger interest and discipline of the institution will be given more importance than individual preference. In the 'Aishat Shifa vs. State of Karnataka' case in the Supreme Court, the two judges had a split verdict, so there is no final decision on this issue yet. The court stated that the school is not imposing any restrictions on the student's faith, but is merely expecting adherence to institutional discipline and uniforms. Following this, the court dismissed the petition.

stories.summary: There is a rain alert across the entire state of UP today. A heavy rain warning has been issued for 16 districts, including Prayagraj. It has been raining in Varanasi since 11 PM last night, and it has continued until Tuesday morning. Due to the rain, waterlogging has occurred in many areas, and car wheels have been submerged. Meanwhile, rivers and drains are overflowing due to continuous rain. 19 districts are affected by floods. Crops in 92 villages have been damaged, and 26 villages have become islands. In Lalitpur, a bridge built over the Sair drain was submerged. A young man attempted to cross the bridge with his bike amidst the strong current, causing his bike to be swept away. Fortunately, the young man narrowly escaped. In Ballia's Bhojpurwa village, a sudden flood occurred in the Saryu River on Sunday. About 100 families here remained trapped throughout the night. The NDRF arrived at 8 AM on Monday and rescued the families by boat. A water tank built in the village was swallowed by the Ganga; a video of this has also surfaced. Meanwhile, it rained in 65 cities on Monday. In Mathura, it rained so heavily that the underpass was filled with up to 2 feet of water. Roads turned into ponds, and cars were half-submerged. Many bikes and autos also got stuck in the water and broke down. Roads in Noida were submerged due to rain. Water accumulated near the stairs of the Sector 62 metro station. In Lucknow, there was rain accompanied by strong winds in the evening. 4 people died in incidents related to rain and flooding. In Bikapur, Ayodhya, a hut collapsed due to a strong storm and rain. A child and a young woman sitting under the thatched roof died after being buried under the debris. A youth lost his life due to drowning in floodwaters in Ghazipur. In Mughalsarai, an innocent child died after a mud wall collapsed. Pictures of rain and floods... Lucknow meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh stated- Monsoon activities have intensified due to a cyclonic system formed over Eastern UP and a low-pressure area formed in the Bay of Bengal. Light to moderate rainfall will continue in Eastern UP for the next few days. Very heavy rainfall is expected in the southern parts of Eastern UP. Due to westerly winds, the possibility of heavy or intense rainfall in Western UP is currently very low. See which districts might receive rainfall today
