stories.title: Mayawati calls Akhilesh arrogant, demands apology to Jayant:Calls ‘turning a nobody into a somebody’ remark shameful; says SP exploited Brahmins
stories.summary: BSP chief Mayawati has hit out at Akhilesh Yadav over his remark, “turned four annas into a rupee.” Calling the SP chief arrogant, she said, “The statement reflects his 'indecent conduct'.” She alleged, “Akhilesh had insulted the family of former Prime Minister Chaudhary Charan Singh.” Mayawati said, “Akhilesh should immediately apologize not only to RLD leader Jayant Chaudhary but also to the entire Jat community, the Samajwadi Party has consistently ‘oppressed’ Brahmins.” Mayawati made these remarks in a post on X on Saturday morning, Due to SP's arrogant attitude, BSP's alliance with Mulayam Singh Yadav broke down quickly in 1993. After this, on June 2, 1995, a conspiracy was hatched to kill me. The infamous Lucknow State Guest House incident happened against me. Mayawati said, “Akhilesh Yadav had also assured me that he would not repeat the mistakes made by his father in the past. Trusting this assurance, the SP and BSP joined hands for the Lok Sabha elections. However, the election results did not meet expectations.” Soon after, the alliance between the two parties fell apart. Mayawati tole, “This happened because of the SP’s “arrogant and selfish” attitude.” Read Mayawati’s 3 key points 1. SP changes colors like a chameleon for its own benefit Mayawati said, “The Samajwadi Party knows how to use alliances only for its own political benefit. Once its purpose is served, the party “changes colors like a chameleon” and later uses inappropriate language against its former allies, the SP’s long-standing attitude and urged people from all communities to remain cautious of its 'narrow and casteist politics'.” 2. Akhilesh gives different meanings to ‘P’ in PDA for political gain Mayawati alleged, “Akhilesh Yadav interprets the “P” in his PDA formula differently according to his political interests. At times, he links it to backward classes, while at other times he associates it with the interests of Pandits.” She further alleged, “Apart from its own caste among the backward classes, the SP has not worked in the interests of other OBCs, minorities and, particularly, the Brahmin community.” 3. It was difficult for women to step out during SP rule Mayawati alleged, “During previous SP governments, Dalits, backward classes, minorities and especially the Brahmin community were exploited and oppressed, with no meaningful steps taken for their welfare. Goons, criminals, mafias and anarchic elements benefited under SP rule, while law and order remained poor, it was difficult for women and girls to step out of their homes during that period." Mayawati appealed to people from all sections of society not to allow the SP to return to power in the upcoming Assembly elections, calling it a matter of public interest. She said, “The BSP would never compromise on the principles of self-respect and dignity championed by Baba Saheb Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar, the party would remain committed to its Ambedkarite ideology and the principle of “Sarvajan Hitay, Sarvajan Sukhay” welfare and happiness for all.” Jayant had counterattacked on Akhilesh's statement Now, read about the guest house incident mentioned by BSP supremo

stories.title: Anti-encroachment drive conducted outside Gorakhpur station:Carts and vendors removed; parking challans issued
stories.summary: On Friday, a joint team of Railway Administration, Traffic Police, and Municipal Corporation conducted an anti-encroachment drive around Gorakhpur Railway Station. During this campaign, which was carried out on both outer sides of the station and in surrounding areas, illegally placed handcarts, vendors, and other encroachments on the road and station pathways were removed. Additionally, challans were issued for unauthorised parked vehicles. Passengers facing problems due to traffic jams Station Director Ratandeep Gupta stated that for the past several days, continuous complaints of traffic jams were being received from around Gorakhpur Railway Station. A large number of unauthorised carts and vendors were standing outside the station. Additionally, many people used to park their two-wheelers unauthorizedly on the roadside. Because of this, the road around the station would narrow, and traffic was getting affected. The biggest problem was being faced by passengers reaching the station to catch trains. Many passengers had complained that they feared missing their train due to getting stuck in traffic. Railways, municipal corporation, and traffic police took joint action A joint campaign was launched to improve passenger convenience and traffic management around the station. The campaign was led by Station Director Gorakhpur Ratandeep Gupta, Additional Municipal Commissioner Atul Kumar, and SP Traffic Amit Kumar Srivastava. During this time, employees from various departments of the Municipal Corporation, Railway Protection Force (RPF), and the commercial department team of the Railways were also present at the spot. The joint team inspected the roads around the station and the entry-exit routes, taking action to remove encroachments. Challans issued for unauthorised vehicles During the campaign, action was taken against several two-wheelers parked unauthorizedly on the road around the station. Challans were issued for such vehicles, and drivers were warned not to park vehicles illegally on the road. Along with this, unauthorized stalls and other temporary encroachments set up on the road and the station's path were also removed. Officials clarified that action would be taken against those who encroach again around the station. Passengers should not face difficulty in catching trains Officials stated that the main objective of the campaign is to provide passengers with a clean and smooth path to reach the station. If there is no traffic congestion around the station, passengers will be able to reach the station on time, and the problem of missing trains will also be reduced. Officials said that unauthorised carts, vendors, and vehicles will not be allowed to park on the road to keep the traffic system smooth outside the station. Campaign will continue further Railway administration, municipal corporation, and traffic police clarified that this action will not be limited to just one day. Joint anti-encroachment campaigns will be conducted from time to time to ensure passenger convenience and unobstructed access to the station. Officials say that along with improving the traffic system around the station, priority is being given to the safety and convenience of passengers, so that they do not face any problems while coming to and going from the station and can catch their trains on time.

stories.title: ‘He killed my daughter for refusing to marry him’:Varanasi M.Sc student’s father says, ‘He wanted property, not love; blackmailed her extensively’
stories.summary: If my Shreya had ever been in trouble, she would definitely have called us. We started calling her from 2:30 pm that day, but she did not answer even once. After that, my daughter never came back. She was murdered. My daughter deserves justice. Shreya's mother breaks down and faints while recounting the incident in Varanasi. She still remembers the morning when her 22-year-old daughter, M.Sc student Shreya Upadhyay, leaves home for college as usual. However, Shreya never returns. Her body is later found in the bathroom of her friend Vivek Chaubey's rented room, around 5 km from her home. The bathroom door is reportedly locked from the outside. After regaining consciousness, Shreya's mother alleges that Vivek repeatedly blackmails her daughter. Shreya's father, in tears, alleges that Vivek does not love his only daughter but has his eyes on the family's property. He says Shreya does not want to marry Vivek, so the family arranges her marriage elsewhere. ‘He pressured her to marry him’ According to Shreya's family, Vivek continues pressuring her to marry him and also threatens her mother. The family alleges that Vivek takes Shreya to his room while she is on her way to college and kills her. Shreya's body is found at around 1:30 pm on August 20 (Thursday) in the bathroom of Vivek's rented room. To understand the family's grief and learn the full sequence of events, the Dainik Bhaskar team visits Rajatalab Marui-Jamuni village, around 22 km from Varanasi city, and speaks to Shreya's family members. ‘Daughter refused to marry vivek’ Shreya's mother, Rita Upadhyay, says people are spreading rumours that her daughter ran away from home. She says, That is not true. She went to college as she did every day. My daughter was not at fault. If she had done something wrong, perhaps she would still be alive today. Shreya's father, Sunil Upadhyay, says Vivek proposes marriage around one-and-a-half years ago, but the family does not agree. When he asks Shreya, she also refuses. My daughter tells me, ‘Dad, I will not marry him. Sunil says the family explains the situation to Vivek and his relatives. Their neighbours, who are also Vivek's relatives, assure the family that he will not trouble Shreya anymore. Vivek threatened, ‘I will also see how the wedding takes place’ Father Sunil Upadhyay said, Vivek must have been counselled by his relatives. For some time he was fine, but after some time he started coming and going again. He kept talking about marrying Shreya. We fixed Shreya's wedding in a nearby village. The engagement took place and the wedding date was set for February 2027.After this, Vivek became aggressive. He had threatened Shreya's mother, saying, ‘I will see how the wedding happens.’ Now Vivek has killed my daughter. Shreya's aunt said that Vivek had already threatened to kill Shreya's father. Vivek just wanted to marry Shreya, but Shreya was silent due to fear and pressure. Cousin asked police to break the lock, but they refused Shreya's cousin Anshuman Upadhyay alleges that Vivek escapes due to police negligence. He says that when Shreya does not return home by the evening of August 18, he goes to the police station and asks the police to trace her phone. According to Anshuman, the phone's location is traced to the Bachhaw area, where Vivek has a rented room. He says, I go there myself after getting the location, but find nothing. I inform the police, after which the station in-charge and other policemen reach the spot. The room is locked. We tell the police that Shreya's phone location is showing this place and ask them to break the lock, check inside and recover the phone. But the police refuse. Police say both are adults The family alleges that the police do not break open the lock, saying they do not have the authority to do so. The police also tell them that both Shreya and Vivek are adults and may have gone somewhere together. Family members then question people living nearby and learn that Shreya has left the area. The police team subsequently leaves the spot. Anshuman says, If the police had broken the door that night, we would have known what had happened to Shreya. Even if something had happened to her, the accused would not have had enough time to escape. We could have caught him immediately. Shreya's body found after searching Family members said that we continued to search for Shreya the next day as well. We kept gathering information about Vivek and reaching his potential hideouts. During this time, the family reached Vivek's relatives' place. His bag was found there, which contained the key to his rented room. We took the key and went back to the same room in Bachhaw, which we had previously reached with the police. The mother hoped that perhaps they would find some clue about her daughter. But, as soon as the door was opened, a strong foul smell emanated from inside. The family went inside and looked in the bathroom, where Shreya's decomposed body was found. How Vivek knew Shreya?

stories.title: Pay bribe, get Ram Lalla darshan in Ayodhya:Pay more and cop will accompany you, even arrange a reel; full deal exposed in sting
stories.summary: "You will be able to have darshan at Ram Mandir. We will get the protocol issued from the Magistrate's office, then the Sub-Inspector himself will take you and arrange the darshan." This is the statement of Shubham Dubey, a tout who arranges darshan outside the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya. He is part of a gang that arranges darshan for money. The charge is ₹7,300. In reality, there is no fee for darshan at Ram Mandir. Even after the revelation of theft of offerings at Ram Mandir, Champat Rai might have been removed from the temple's management, but the system has not improved. Here, some influential people are still running a darshan nexus. For money, these people are also getting photos and reels made in the restricted area of the temple. This is charged separately. Dainik Bhaskar conducted an investigation into this. Read the full revelation In our investigation, 3 ways of arranging darshan for money at Ayodhya's Ram Mandir came to light, which are as follows- 1- VVIP Protocol in the name of Minister-Officer: Brokers take money in the name of officers-ministers and arrange darshan. This includes police personnel and employees stationed at the VIP gate, who are running a darshan nexus in collusion with brokers. 2- With Mahants-Priests: In this, after taking money, mahants-priests themselves accompany and arrange darshan. Hotel owners provide them with customers. 3- Passes even when slots are full: In this, entry passes are being sold for money even when slot bookings on the website are full. This involves collusion between temple employees and brokers. We contacted broker Shubham Dubey outside the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya. Shubham made a deal to arrange darshan under VVIP protocol. Darshan Nexus-1 Reporter : Will VVIP darshan be possible? Shubham : Yes, we will arrange it. Someone will go with you and facilitate the darshan. Reporter : At what time will you arrange the darshan? Shubham : We can arrange the darshan right now. We will get a wireless message from the Magistrate's office, and VVIP entry will be arranged. Then you can show your Aadhaar card and go straight inside. Reporter : Who will accompany us? Shubham : The Daroga (Sub-Inspector) will go with you and arrange your darshan. If the police accompany you, the darshan will be excellent. You all come at 4 PM. Reporter : There won't be any problem, right? Shubham: No problem. With the pass, you will go in the VIP line, but the Sub-Inspector will take you to VVIP. Your protocol will arrive via wireless from the Magistrate's office. Your VVIP darshan will be guaranteed. Sub-Inspector facilitated darshan for ₹7,300, made a reel in a restricted area Shubham introduced us to another tout, Vimal Mishra. He took ₹7,300 from us and took us to the gate. Here, he introduced us to Sub-Inspector Rajesh Kumar. Then, after depositing mobile, wallet, and other belongings in the gate's locker, Vimal and Sub-Inspector Rajesh took us for darshan. Photo-video is prohibited in the temple premises, but in the presence of the Sub-Inspector himself, tout Vimal took our photos and also made a reel. Now we reached Hanumangarhi to have darshan at Ram Mandir through priests. Here we met hotelier Manoj. He introduced us to Arun Pandey, who was selling prasad. Arun called priest Pawandas. Pawandas made a deal to take us to Ram Mandir for darshan. Darshan Nexus-2 Reporter: Maharaj ji, will you arrange the darshan? Pawandas: Yes, we will arrange it. Reporter: How much will it cost? Pawandas: I told you, it will cost ₹1,200. Reporter: No, please reduce it a bit. Okay, take ₹1,000. Pawandas: Alright, fine. After this, priest Pawandas took us to the VIP gate of the Ram Mandir. Here, he submitted photocopies of our Aadhar cards. Then, he took us along and arranged VIP darshan of Ramlala and Ram Darbar. Despite slot booking being full, can a darshan pass be made by paying money? To find this out, we met broker Mohandas. He has a nexus with the Ram Mandir staff. He arranged for the darshan pass and sent it through his brother Ganesh. Darshan Nexus-3 Ganesh : Your passes have been made. Reporter : Give us the passes. Ganesh : What will you do with the passes? You're concerned with VIP darshan, aren't you? VIP darshan will happen. Reporter : What did we pay you for? We need the passes? Ganesh: Okay, wait, we are getting them for you. (Then Ganesh called someone and got the passes. He said) See, your passes are ready. You can take a photo of this. (We took photos of the passes that came on Ganesh's phone) Ganesh: When I've given my word, it won't be wrong. Look, check your name and Aadhaar number on the pass, it's correct, isn't it? SSP said, ‘Action will be taken against those who charge money for darshan’ Ayodhya SSP Dr. Gaurav Grover said, ‘Normal and easy darshan at Ram Mandir are completely free. For some saints, seers, or specific individuals in Ayodhya, proper passes are issued for easy/VIP darshan. The police have no role in this.’

stories.title: Boy starts barking after dog bite in Mirzapur:Doctor advises keeping him in a dark room; recovers in 22 days, first such case in UP
stories.summary: On March 16, a video of a 15-year-old boy from Mirzapur surfaces in which he is seen barking like a dog. Saliva continuously drips from his mouth, and he is unable to drink water. The boy, Karan, develops these symptoms after being bitten by a dog in December. He does not receive anti-rabies injections at the time. The doctor tells the family, ‘Lock him in a dungeon; he will die in three to four days.’ Hearing this, Karan's disabled father loses hope. However, four months after the incident, Karan is now completely healthy and attending school. His recovery is being described as the first reported case in Uttar Pradesh of a patient surviving after reaching the final stage of rabies. Here is the complete sequence of events. How Karan was bitten by a dog, what negligence occurred Karan says, On December 8, 2025, my maternal uncle Kanhaiya Lal passed away. His Terahvin (13th-day ritual) was on December 20. I had gone to my uncle's house in Harhua, Varanasi. Anil Kumar's house is in their neighborhood. He is also my maternal uncle by relation. He has a native breed dog. A 5-6 year old child was feeding something to the dog. When I pulled the child towards me, the dog bit my hand. Perhaps it thought I was hitting the child. Karan further said, People took me to the doctor. There, I got a tetanus injection. Then I came home with my father. I knew about rabies, so I also went to the hospital to get its injection. But it was very crowded there. A hospital employee claimed that if I had already received a tetanus injection, there was no need for a rabies injection. Believing him, I came home. Suddenly felt dizzy, fell down, and started barking Karan's father, Bhaiyalal, says his son shows no signs of rabies for around four months. The family is poor, and Bhaiyalal has suffered a paralysis attack. To support the family, Karan sometimes works as a labourer. On the evening of March 13, Karan returns from work and suddenly falls outside the house. The family picks him up and gives him medicine, after which he appears fine. However, the next morning, he falls again and starts barking. He cannot speak when asked anything, leaving his family frightened. Bhaiyalal says Karan's condition initially makes the family suspect a supernatural problem. They take him to the Ram-Janaki temple in Kachhwa Bazaar, where prayers continue for some time. As Karan's condition worsens, they take him to a nearby hospital. The doctor says he cannot be treated there, so the family takes him to Kachhwa Christian Hospital, where he is admitted briefly before being referred to Mirzapur District Hospital. At Mirzapur District Hospital, Karan receives one or two injections, but doctors say he will not recover there and advise the family to take him to Varanasi. By then, it is night, so Bhaiyalal takes Karan home. He continues barking throughout the night. The next day, the family manages to arrange an ambulance to take him to Varanasi. BHU doctors say, ‘Lock him in a dark room’ Karan is still barking when he reaches BHU and cannot speak, although he understands everything. He recalls doctors telling the family that he will not survive and advising them to lock him alone in a dark room, keep everyone away from him and not let anyone touch him. They say he will die within three to four days. Doctors give this advice because Karan is trying to bite people and is considered to be in the final stage of rabies. Bhaiyalal says the family's courage breaks after hearing this. They tell doctors that even if Karan cannot survive, they want to take him home. Doctors then suggest taking him to Kapil Chaura Hospital for another opinion. At Kapil Chaura Hospital, two doctors sprinkle a little water on Karan, causing him to tremble. They offer him water, but he cannot drink it. The doctors also lose hope and the family then takes him to Rama Center Hospital, where doctors again say there is no hope of survival and advise them to take him away. Karan's recovery story Bhaialal says, 'When we gave up after showing him to everyone in Varanasi, I called my in-laws. My brother-in-law's son said to bring him to Harhua (a town in Varanasi) to us. There was a relative named Suman, who was at the Harhua Primary Health Center but had retired. He saw Karan and then got him a rabies vaccine the next morning. Three days later, he got another vaccine. Bhaialal says, After a week, the third vaccine was administered. Two more vaccines were given in the next two weeks. A total of 5 rabies vaccines were given in about 22 days. Karan started recovering. We brought him home. After a month, he started having problems again. We called the doctor there, and they called him back and gave two more vaccines at 1-week intervals. Now Karan is perfectly fine. When Karan's health deteriorated, 2 videos went viral- Karan studies in class 9 We asked if anything changed after the dog incident? Karan says that it's still the same as before. He enjoys studying. His friends also play with him. Teachers also don't discriminate in any way. Everyone sits together. Karan's house is about 15 kilometers away from Mirzapur district headquarters, near Kachhwa market. Karan has 2 elder brothers and one sister. His mother passed away about 10 years ago. Four years ago, his father Bhaiyalal also suffered a paralysis attack. Now he stays at home. How did he recover from rabies? Rabies is an incurable disease. So how did he recover? We understood this from the doctor who treated Karan- 7 ignjections given Dr Santosh Kumar, Superintendent of Harhua Primary Health Centre in Varanasi, says Karan arrives with hydrophobia and barking. He is given an anti-rabies injection, and within 24 hours, his aggression appears to decrease. He says the family is advised to complete the full course. Normally, five anti-rabies doses are given, starting from the day of the dog bite. Although Karan receives treatment late, he completes five doses over 22 days, followed by two additional doses. He is now reportedly fine. Doctor explains why Karan may have survived Dr Devendra Pratap Patel of Pratapgarh District Hospital explains that the location of the dog bite and timing of symptoms can affect how quickly rabies progresses. Karan is bitten on the hand, which is farther from the brain, so the infection may take longer to produce symptoms. A bite on the neck or chest could allow the virus to reach the brain more quickly, making survival much more difficult. Another factor is that the dog is reportedly a pet and may have received an anti-rabies vaccination. This could possibly explain why Karan develops symptoms only after four months. How did the vaccine help after symptoms appeared? Dr Patel says it is possible that the infection has not completely overwhelmed Karan. He also raises the possibility that reading or hearing about rabies may have had a psychological effect on the child after he remembered the dog bite and began barking. He says doctors may have considered the barking as the basis for their assessment. However, he describes the case as unique and says detailed study could help clarify several aspects. How does the rabies vaccine work? Dr Patel explains that a vaccine acts as an antigen. After entering the body, it triggers the production of antibodies against the rabies virus, which takes around 3–4 days. The rabies virus gradually travels towards the brain through the nerves, and the later symptoms are linked to its effect on the brain.

stories.title: Is Champat hinting at scam in Ram Temple construction?:Letter appears to suggest so; Nripendra hasn’t met Champat since donation theft
stories.summary: The ‘internal strife’ that began after the alleged theft of offerings at the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple has now surfaced openly. After indications that the SIT investigation report gives him a clean chit, Champat Rai Bansal issues a nine-page letter in which Nripendra Misra, chairman of the Ram Temple Construction Committee, comes directly under scrutiny. A member associated with the temple trust says that after the offering theft came to light, Nripendra Misra corners Champat Rai in an interview by raising questions over security arrangements, deletion of CCTV footage and the deployment of more than 1,500 employees. Following this, Champat Rai reportedly distances himself from the controversy and goes into ‘solitude’ at Karsevakpuram in Ayodhya. During this period, his opponents believe that Champat’s influence has weakened. However, he remains quiet and waits for the right opportunity. As soon as the SIT report is presented in court, he launches a direct counter-attack through the letter. Nripendra visits Ayodhya every 15 days, but does not meet Champat Champat Rai also appears upset over Nripendra Misra’s frequent visits to Ayodhya. Misra visits the city roughly every 15 days to attend meetings of the construction committee before returning to Lucknow or Delhi. According to the temple trust member, whenever Nripendra Misra visits Ayodhya, he does not meet Champat Rai. This suggests that the differences between the two are not limited to correspondence and that communication between them has almost broken down. Another dimension of the dispute is their contrasting backgrounds. Nripendra Misra is a former IAS officer, while Champat Rai comes from the Vishwa Hindu Parishad (VHP), which has been directly associated with the Ram Temple movement. In his letter, Champat Rai alleges that Nripendra Misra has always considered himself the supreme authority on decisions related to temple construction. He alleges that there is hardly any decision related to the temple's construction that the construction committee does not take on its own. Even when the Trust makes a suggestion, he claims, it is either rejected or the existing construction is removed. The tone of the letter indicates strong objections over the alleged lack of transparency in the selection of companies and financial decisions related to the temple's construction. Champat’s move seen as attempt to limit Misra’s interference Champat Rai's latest move is being viewed as a strategy to limit Nripendra Misra's influence in temple-related affairs. However, construction of the temple is expected to continue until after March 2027. Once the remaining construction work is handed over to the Trust, the Trust itself will decide what role, if any, the construction committee will have. When contacted by Dainik Bhaskar, Nripendra Misra said: I can say something only after seeing the letter. I have not read the letter yet. I cannot believe that Champat Rai has written something for me in the letter. 9-page letter contains 33 points Champat Rai's nine-page letter contains 33 points covering the temple's construction journey from the Ram Temple movement to the present. Through the letter, Rai for the first time raises strong objections to Nripendra Misra's working style and alleged unilateral decision-making. stories.title: UP govt to create jobs for Gen Z:Jan Seva Kendra 4.0 to launch; Yogi Cabinet may approve over 19 proposals tomorrow
stories.summary: The state government will provide employment and self-employment opportunities to young people under the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Employment and Industrial Development Scheme (SVPEIZ). The scheme may be approved at the Yogi Cabinet meeting to be held on Tuesday. New electric buses will be added to the Transport Department's fleet. At the same time, revised rules for operating Jan Seva Kendras will be approved. An official of the IT and Electronics Department said that the term of Jan Seva Kendra 3.0 had ended on 30 June 2026. Jan Seva Kendra 4.0 is being launched to extend the programme. The Cabinet meeting will be held on Tuesday under the chairmanship of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. Chief Secretary S.P. Goyal released the agenda for the Cabinet meeting on Monday. The agenda includes around 19 proposals. Integrated Manufacturing and Logistics Clusters will be established in Sultanpur along the Purvanchal Expressway. The Ganga Expressway will be extended from Meerut to Haridwar, and a proposal to build the Jhansi Link Expressway may also be approved. 1,323 new vehicles will be purchased for the district units of the Uttar Pradesh Police to replace old and scrapped vehicles. The Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Employment and Industrial Area Development Scheme will be approved. The government assistance policy to promote private investment in the development of private hospitals in the state of Uttar Pradesh will be approved. The proposal for the first amendment to the Uttar Pradesh Police (Recruitment of Efficient Sportspersons) and Promotion Without Passing Through the Ranks Rules, 2021, will be approved. The Uttar Pradesh Assistant Development Officer (Panchayat) Service (Second Amendment) Rules, 2026, may be approved. The plan for the implementation and operation of the Jan Seva Kendra 4.0 project in Uttar Pradesh may be approved. A proposal of ₹272.25 crore for the establishment of Integrated Manufacturing and Logistics Clusters in Sultanpur, near the Purvanchal Expressway, under the Industrial Corridor Scheme will be approved. The proposal for the Jhansi Link Expressway project will be approved. The proposal to extend the Ganga Expressway from Meerut to Haridwar will be approved. The recommendations made at the meeting of the High-Level Empowered Committee held on 4 May 2026, under the Uttar Pradesh Industrial Investment and Employment Promotion Policy, 2022, may be approved. The proposals related to Foreign Direct Investment (FDI), Foreign Capital Investment (FCI), Fortune Global 500 companies, and Fortune investments may be approved. The guidelines for the Chief Minister Handloom Weaver Prosperity Scheme may be approved. An approval of ₹400 crore will be granted for the purchase of new electric buses. Approval will be granted for the payment of outstanding dues to district and block coordinators and education motivators working under the Sakshar Bharat Scheme. The proposal to transfer six hectares of Gram Sabha land near Saman Bird Sanctuary in Mainpuri to the Tourism Department free of charge for tourism development may be approved. The Allahabad High Court Court Managers Centralized Service Rules, 2026, may be approved.

stories.title: Wife donates kidney to teacher husband in Agra:“For the man I vowed to live and die with, a kidney is nothing”; father-in-law calls her 'Savitri'
stories.summary: For the first time, a kidney transplant was performed at SN Medical College in Agra. The first transplant was that of teacher Mahendra Kushwaha. His wife, Meena, gave her husband a new lease on life by donating one of her kidneys. Now, both Mahendra and Meena are healthy and under the supervision of doctors. On Monday, Meena spoke to her husband via video call. She asked, "Are you okay?" Meena said that for the person with whom she vowed to live and die, a kidney is nothing. "I am very happy that my kidney was useful to my husband," she said, her eyes welling up with tears. After talking to her husband for 2 minutes, Meena felt relieved. She thanked God and the doctors. Now read the full story Mahendra Kushwaha (32), a resident of Sikandra Rao in Hathras, teaches at a private school. A year and a half ago, he discovered that his kidneys were failing. Since then, he had been undergoing regular dialysis. His body was becoming weaker. His wife, Meena, used to bring him to SN Medical College herself for dialysis. Along with raising their three children, Meena also managed the household. The doctor informed Meena that Mahendra's life could be saved if he underwent a kidney transplant. Due to the high costs in private hospitals, arranging the money for the transplant became a challenge for Mahendra and Meena. In the meantime, they learned about the commencement of kidney transplant services at SN Medical College. Following this, Meena got her husband examined, completed the registration, and decided to donate her own kidney. Husband and wife spoke via video call 3 days after the transplant Meena's test reports also came back normal. Following this, Mahendra's kidney transplant was performed at SN Medical College on 22 August. This was the first time in the history of the medical college that such a surgery was conducted. Since then, Meena and Mahendra have been admitted to the isolation ward at SN. On Monday, doctors arranged a video call for the couple, during which they inquired about each other's health. Meena said took the decision to donate the kidney in a minute Meena said: “When I found out that both of my husband's kidneys had failed, the only option left was a transplant. When the topic of donating a kidney came up, I decided to donate my kidney to my husband within a minute.” Father-in-law said: ‘Daughter-in-law became Savitri for my son’ Mahendra's father, Pappu Singh, also spoke to his son. He mentioned that his son's condition is stable. Pappu Singh is blessing his daughter-in-law Meena for this sacrifice. He says that she has come as a Savitri for his son. For us, she is no less than a goddess. Spoke to husband on video call Due to the risk of infection and medical guidelines, Meena cannot meet her husband Mahendra directly for a few days. Therefore, with the help of the hospital administration, the two were able to talk via video call. Dr. Apoorv Jain, Head of the Department of Nephrology, stated that the patient underwent various tests, including kidney function tests. All results are normal. Urine production has started, liquid food has been provided, and the patient has also started sitting up. The patient will be discharged after 2 weeks.

stories.title: Brought girlfriend from UP on pretext of Balaji darshan, strangled:Crushed her face with stones on a hill; she was pressuring him to leave his wife
stories.summary: The Mehandipur police station in Dausa solved a blind murder case of a girl on Monday. The lover had murdered his girlfriend due to an extramarital affair. Both were married, and the girlfriend was pressuring the youth to leave his wife. Disturbed by this, the lover brought his girlfriend 270 kilometers away from Bulandshahr to Mehandipur Balaji (Dausa). Under the pretext of taking her to the Mora Mata temple, he took her to a hill and, along with a friend, strangled her to death. To prevent identification, Sangeeta's face was crushed with a stone. The incident occurred on 17 August. The police stated that they examined the CCTV footage of the route to the Mehandipur Balaji temple. In the footage, the young woman was seen walking with two youths. The photos of all three were sent to police stations in various districts of Rajasthan, UP, and Madhya Pradesh for verification. The young woman, Sangeeta (22), was a resident of Bulandshahr. The accused have been identified as Gajendra Meena (28), a resident of Jirajpur village under the Ahmadgarh police station area of Bulandshahr, UP, and his friend Vivek Meena, a resident of Azizabad under the Pahasu police station area. He was married and wanted to get rid of his girlfriend Additional SP Shankarlal Meena stated that Gajendra Meena had gotten married just a few months ago. His girlfriend, Sangeeta, was pressuring Gajendra to leave his wife. Gajendra became troubled by this. To get rid of his girlfriend Sangeeta, he planned her murder. He also involved his friend Vivek Meena in the murder plot. Brought under the pretext of visiting Mehandipur Balaji The Additional SP stated that Gajendra had promised to marry Sangeeta and suggested visiting Mehandipur Balaji. Sangeeta agreed. Following this, on 17 August, Gajendra, his friend Vivek, and Sangeeta traveled 270 kilometers from Bulandshahr to reach Mehandipur Balaji (Dausa). Gajendra had thought that devotees from all over the country visit Mehandipur Balaji. There is also a hilly area there. He believed that he would be able to commit the crime and return, and the police would not be able to reach him. Due to the crowd at Balaji, he did not get a chance. After this, he suggested going to Mora Mata, located on a hill near the temple. The three reached the Mora Mata temple. Seeing a deserted spot on the way, Gajendra strangled Sangeeta. When she became unconscious, both friends crushed her face with stones so that she could not be identified. It was a blind murder, no evidence of identity was found Additional SP Shankarlal Meena said: “On the afternoon of 17 August, the girl's blood-stained body was found in the bushes on the way to the Mora Mata temple. The girl's face was crushed with stones, making it impossible to identify her. Devotees from all over the country come to the Balaji temple. In such a situation, it was difficult to identify the girl. After this, a team was formed under the guidance of the SP and IG, which included me (Addl. SP Shankarlal), the Balaji Police Station SHO, and members of the Cyber Cell and DST.” Matched CCTV footage with the girl's clothes Shankarlal Meena stated: “The girl was wearing a yellow suit. We scanned the CCTV footage of the route to the Mehandipur Balaji temple. After this, a girl wearing a yellow suit was seen walking with two youths. We sent the photos of all three to police stations in various districts of Rajasthan, UP, and Madhya Pradesh for verification.” “To reach the accused, our teams travelled to Dausa, Jaipur, Alwar, Karauli, Sawai Madhopur, Deeg, Bharatpur, and Dholpur, as well as Mathura, Aligarh, Agra, Firozabad, Etah, Mainpuri, and Budaun in Uttar Pradesh, and Gwalior and Ujjain in Madhya Pradesh. We sent the photos to the local police stations, GRP, and control rooms there and requested information,” Shankarlal Meena said. Police traveled 700 kilometers The teams attempted to identify the suspects by pasting their photographs in public places, including bus stands, hotels, restaurants, railway stations, and dharamshalas. The girl was identified through the Bulandshahr police, and subsequently, her boyfriend and his friend were identified based on call details. The team traveled 700 kilometers to solve the case and apprehended the accused, Gajendra and Vivek, in Bulandshahr. During interrogation, both confessed to their crime.

stories.title: Ayodhya mahant Raju Das abuses Congress spokesperson:Says ‘I’ll hit you with my shoe’ during live debate on fish feast
stories.summary: A dispute broke out on Monday during a live debate on a television channel between Raju Das, the mahant of Hanumangarhi in Ayodhya, and Congress spokesperson Kunwar Singh Nishad. Raju Das hurled a barrage of abuses at the Congress spokesperson and threatened him, saying, "I will beat you with my shoes." Hearing this, both female anchors were left stunned. The programme had to be ended midway. The debate was about a fish feast. The Congress party called the incident an insult to democratic dialogue and the standards of public life. Dr. C.P. Rai, chairman of the Uttar Pradesh Congress media department, said, "Turning to abuse as a weapon when arguments run out in a political debate is a serious cause for concern for the democratic system. Abusing someone's mother, making personal remarks, or using threatening language is neither a mark of sainthood nor a reflection of Sanatan values or democratic conduct." Read 3 key points from the Congress... Saffron robes do not place anyone above the law: No person can claim the right to abuse or intimidate a political worker under the guise of religious office or influence. Saffron robes do not place anyone above the law, and religious identity is not a license to publicly insult another citizen. Whether the platform is a television studio or a temple, the same standards of decorum should apply to everyone. Congress Workers Are Not Afraid of Abuse: Congress workers are not afraid of abuse or threats. The Congress believes in the Constitution and the law, and is committed to answering political questions through democratic means. The party has demanded an impartial investigation into the complete original recording of the event, video footage, and available digital evidence. If the allegations are found to be true, action should be taken in accordance with the law. Abuse Will Be Answered with Reason: Those who hurl abuse will be answered with reason, and those who issue threats will be answered with the strength of the Constitution. The Congress will stand firmly against any attempt to undermine democratic dialogue and the dignity of public life. Now find out why Raju Das became furious at the event. Anchor: Kunwar Singh Nishad, Congress spokesperson, is also joining us. Kunwar Singh, please explain what was the justification for this? Mahant Raju Das is saying that after visiting the temple and returning from a pilgrimage site, you ate fish and rice. You could have had something else prepared and eaten, couldn't you? Kunwar Singh Nishad: It was an event of the Nishad community, where Rajendra Pal Gautam and Ajay Rai had come. In this country, taking bribes is not a crime; corruption is not a crime; hooliganism in the BJP is not a crime. Killing people in the name of cows is not a crime, but in their view, eating fish is a crime-even though no article of the Constitution states that you cannot eat fish during the month of Sawan. After devouring a hundred rats, the cat goes on a pilgrimage to Mecca. The BJP's national president was eating non-vegetarian food four days ago, even though it is the month of Sawan. But Raju Das was left speechless; Raju Das did not say anything, and no one could utter a word. No one from the media came forward either. (When Raju Das tried to respond, Kunwar Singh attempted to silence him by saying, "Quiet." Raju Das then lost his temper and began hurling abuses at him. The anchor did not know what to make of it and fell silent for a few seconds.) Anchor: I think it is not appropriate to continue this conversation, because you must maintain a certain standard of language. Please speak properly. Anchor: Mahant Raju Das, you are sitting on a national channel, participating in a debate, and appearing on a programme. This kind of language does not suit you. You are a mahant; do not use such language. After this, the anchor thanked both of them and concluded the programme. Why is there controversy over the fish feast? Find out... Fish was prepared at the Congress workers' conference in Ayodhya on Sunday. The attendees were also served the dish. Uttar Pradesh Congress president Ajay Rai was also present at the conference. On Monday, CM Yogi commented on Congress state president Ajay Rai's fish feast, saying, "Congress members insult their heritage. The conduct of the Congress state president is an example of this. They offer prayers at Hanumangarhi and then go outside and indulge in a fish feast. They keep chanting 'Ram-Ram.' Seeing their double standards, even a chameleon must feel embarrassed. It must be wondering what kind of species has been born among us in human form." Yogi said, "A mafia figure (Mukhtar Ansari) murdered his (Ajay Rai's) brother, but this man did not go to testify against him. Instead, he knelt before him and bowed down." Ajay Rai said: “If the CM shows a photo of me eating fish, I will resign” “If the Chief Minister has any photograph, let him show it. I am ready to resign. The Nishad community had invited me yesterday. Whenever I go to Ayodhya, I first visit Hanumangarhi and seek the blessings of Lord Ram, and then attend the event,” Ajay Rai said responding to CM Yogi's statement. “At the Nishad community's event, they were hosting a fish feast; that was their work. I attended the event and returned to Lucknow. Raising, catching, and eating fish is part of the Nishad community's lifestyle. The BJP is insulting the Nishad community, and the Nishad community will not forget this,” he said.

stories.summary: योगी आदित्यनाथ ने राहुल गांधी के मनुस्मृति को लेकर दिए बयान पर तीखा हमला बोला। उन्होंने नेता प्रतिपक्ष पर तंज कसते हुए सवाल किया कि वह अर्बन नक्सलियों के हाथों भारत की वर्तमान पीढ़ी के भविष्य को क्यों खराब करना चाहते हैं।

stories.title: गांव पहुंचाने के बहाने महिला को कार में बिठाया, कोल्ड ड्रिंक में नशा देकर रेप
stories.summary: महिला को जब भी कहीं जाना होता था तो समीर को गाड़ी लेकर बुला लेती थी। 10 अगस्त को शाम छह बजे महिला अलीगढ़ स्थित रिश्तेदारी से अपने गांव जा रही थी। वह क्वार्सी चौराहे पर टेंपो का इंतजार कर रही थी। तभी समीर मिल गया। उसने गांव छोड़ने के बहाने महिला को कार में बिठा लिया। आरोप है कि रास्ते में रेप किया।

stories.title: SC to hear Delhi Race Club plea against eviction on August 25
stories.summary: The dispute concerns the club’s occupation of an 84-acre plot on Lok Kalyan Marg. The Centre had argued that the lease granted to the club in 1926 expired on December 31, 1994, and had not been renewed

stories.title: पत्नी को कमरे में बंद कर पति ने खेला खूनी खेल, मिन्नतें करते रहे बच्चे; मां को मार डाला
stories.summary: पति ने आधी रात को पत्नी को कमरे में बंद कर ईंट से कूचकर मार डाला। मां की आवाजें सुनकर जागे बच्चों ने पड़ोसियों से बचाने की मिन्नतें कीं। पड़ोसी पहुंचे भी लेकिन तब तक पति, पत्नी की हत्या की हत्या कर चुका था। हत्या करने के बाद वह मौके से भाग खड़ा हुआ।

stories.title: बालिका गृह से निकलना चाहती थीं, इसलिए... सहेली को डुबोकर मारने वाली बच्चियां बोलीं
stories.summary: मथुरा के राजकीय बालिका संरक्षण गृह में 14 वर्षीय बालिका की हत्या के मामले में पुलिस ने दो बालिकाओं से पूछताछ की, जिन्होंने हत्या की बात स्वीकार की है। अधीक्षिका की तहरीर पर केस दर्ज किया गया। तीन अन्य बालिकाओं पर साजिश में शामिल होने का शक है। पुलिस हत्या के मकसद की जांच कर रही है।

stories.title: Algeria’s schools put Shakespeare before Molière in break from France

stories.title: कांग्रेस के गले में फंसा मछली का कांटा; योगी के हमले पर अजय राय ने फोटो दिखाने की चुनौती दी
stories.summary: सीएम योगी आदित्यनाथ ने सोमवार को रायबरेली में कांग्रेस, राहुल गांधी और अजय राय पर तीखे हमले बोले। उन्होंने रविवार को अयोध्या पहुंचे अजय राय पर मंदिर में दर्शन-पूजन के बाद मछली भोज में शामिल होने का आरोप लगाया। अजय राय ने इस आरोप के जवाब में कहा है कि यदि वह फोटो दिखा दें तो तुरंत इस्तीफा दे दूंगा।

stories.title: लखनऊ के कॉल्विन कॉलेज में शिक्षक बने मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार, छात्रों को पढ़ाया लोकतंत्र और चुनाव का पाठ
stories.summary: UP Election 2027: उत्तर प्रदेश में विधानसभा चुनाव होने की चर्चाओं के बीच निर्वाचन आयोग ने अपनी तैयारियां तेज कर दी हैं। इसी कड़ी में देश के मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार आज यानी सोमवार सुबह 2 दिवसीय दौरे पर राजधानी लखनऊ पहुंचे हैं। इस दौरान मुख्य निर्वाचन आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार अपने पुराने स्कूल कॉल्विन ताल्लुकेदार्स कॉलेज में एक शिक्षक की खास भूमिका में नजर आए। उन्होंने विद्यालय के 11वीं और 12वीं कक्षा के विद्यार्थियों की क्लास ली और उनसे लोकतंत्र चुनाव और मताधिकार जैसे महत्वपूर्ण विषयों पर सीधा संवाद किया। इसके साथ ही उन्होंने भविष्य के मतदाताओं को उनके अधिकारों और जिम्मेदारियों के प्रति पूरी तरह से जागरूक भी किया।

stories.title: यूपी में सीट बंटवारे पर घमासान: अखिलेश ने NDA पर फेंका 162 का जाल, तो ‘इंडिया’ गठबंधन में कांग्रेस ने बढ़ाई सपा की टेंशन
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Election 2027: उत्तर प्रदेश विधानसभा चुनाव से पहले सीट बंटवारे को लेकर सियासी हलचल तेज हो गई है। सपा प्रमुख अखिलेश यादव ने दावा किया है कि भाजपा को अपने सहयोगी दलों के लिए 162 सीटें छोड़नी पड़ेंगी। वहीं, कांग्रेस ने भी सपा पर दबाव बढ़ाते हुए बराबरी और सम्मानजनक सीट बंटवारे की मांग तेज कर दी है। दूसरी ओर, जयंत चौधरी और ओम प्रकाश राजभर के बयानों से गठबंधन की सियासत और गरमा गई है। ऐसे में चुनाव से पहले NDA और इंडिया गठबंधन, दोनों में सीटों का गणित बड़ी चुनौती बनता दिख रहा है।

stories.summary: Ajay Rai Fish Feast Controversy: अयोध्या में कांग्रेस प्रदेश अध्यक्ष अजय राय के स्वागत कार्यक्रम के दौरान हुए कथित मछली भोज को लेकर यूपी की सियासत गरमा गई है। मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ के हमले के बाद अब अजय राय ने पलटवार करते हुए सीएम को खुली चुनौती दी है। राय ने कहा कि अगर मुख्यमंत्री के पास उनकी मछली खाते हुए कोई तस्वीर है तो उसे सार्वजनिक किया जाए। उन्होंने दावा किया कि तस्वीर सामने आते ही वह राजनीति से इस्तीफा देने के लिए तैयार हैं।

stories.summary: बलरामपुर की नगर पंचायत गैसड़ी के खदगौरा वार्ड में सोमवार रात तेंदुआ भेड़ों के बाड़े में घुस गया। तेंदुए को देखकर मची भगदड़ में 88 भेड़ों की मौत हो गई, जबकि 13 घायल हैं। घटना के बाद गांव में दहशत है। ग्रामीणों ने तेंदुए को पकड़ने के लिए पिंजरा लगाने और पशुपालकों को मुआवजा देने की मांग की।

stories.title: BJP should clarify its stand on reservation:Congress in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam says government does not want to give SC, ST, OBCs their due share
stories.summary: Congress state in-charge and former minister Rajendra Pal Gautam launched a sharp attack on the BJP and the state government over the issues of reservation and the national anthem. During a press conference at the state Congress headquarters on Monday, he said the BJP should clarify whether it is in favour of or against reservation. He alleged that Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak had recently held a press conference with students protesting against reservation. In such a situation, BJP should clarify its stand, Rajendra Pal said. Raised the issue of rights of the reserved category in 69,000 teacher recruitment Rajendra Pal said the Deputy CM had talked about providing justice to students and the youth and had assured a meeting with the Union Minister. He questioned what was discussed during the meeting with the Union Minister. Raising the issue of 69,000-teacher recruitment, Gautam said that about eight thousand posts were reserved for SC, ST, and OBC categories, but allegations have surfaced of general category candidates being appointed to these posts. He said the OBC Commission's report also revealed irregularities with candidates from the reserved category. Despite this, no concrete action has been taken by the state government, he alleged, adding that the government ‘is not serious about the rights of backward and Dalit classes’. BJP also targeted over caste census The Congress leader also cornered the BJP on the issue of caste census. He said that the Prime Minister and the Union Home Minister had talked about conducting a caste census, but in the recently released columns related to the census, there is no separate column for OBCs. He said that the BJP should clarify how the OBC, SC, and ST categories will get their constitutional rights. Question over Speaker leaving during national anthem Rajendra Pal Gautam, during an event in Unnao, accused Assembly Speaker Satish Mahana of leaving while the national anthem was being played and demanded action. He stated that a video of this incident has also surfaced. Congress has filed complaints with the police in various districts of the state, demanding an FIR be registered in the alleged case of disrespect to the national anthem, but no case has been registered so far. He questioned whether any Assembly Speaker, minister, or leader is above the Constitution and the law. Gautam asked the state government and police administration what action has been taken against Satish Mahana so far. Also raised the issue of action against Congress workers The Congress leader alleged that no action is being taken against the Assembly Speaker in the national anthem case, while FIRs are registered against Congress workers for minor issues. Referring to the action taken during the protest by Congress workers in Kanpur, he accused the police administration of working under pressure from the government. Rajendra Pal Gautam demanded that an FIR be registered against Satish Mahana in the case of alleged disrespect to the national anthem and that the state government take immediate strict action in the matter.

stories.title: Thief enters Noida flat wearing salwar suit:Steals ₹2 lakh in 13 minutes, face covered with red dupatta
stories.summary: Two lakh rupees cash was stolen from a flat in Mahagun Meadows Society in Greater Noida. In the incident that took place on Saturday evening, the thief entered the flat wearing a salwar suit. He broke the locker, took the cash, and fled. The theft was captured on CCTV cameras. The CCTV shows that the thief entered the flat around 7:40 PM. He was wearing a black salwar suit. His face was covered with a red dupatta. 13 minutes later, at 7:53 PM, he exited the flat. A broken mirror was also found in the kitchen. The incident took place in Sector-150. Watch the footage of the incident Husband and wife had gone to sister's house, returned to find the locker broken Flat owner Abhishek Sharma said he lives in Tower-B with his wife Sejal Goyal. On Saturday evening, both went to his sister's house. During this, their domestic helper called his wife's mobile phone and inquired about their presence at home. “Late at night, around 12 o'clock, when we returned to the flat, we found the locker broken. The ₹2 lakh cash kept in it was missing,” Abhishek said, adding that he checked the CCTV footage and the entire incident of theft came to light. Suspected domestic helper and electrician Abhishek suspected his domestic helper and electrician of being involved in the theft. A complaint has been filed at Knowledge Park Kotwali. Based on the complaint, the police have registered a case and started investigation. Knowledge Park Station House Officer Vinod Kumar said- Efforts are being made to identify the suspect based on CCTV footage and other evidence.

stories.title: CEC gets emotional after visit to his school:Says ‘That was one era, this is another’; tells students, ‘Lucknow is my Karmabhoomi’
stories.summary: India's Chief Election Commissioner, Gyanesh Kumar, is on a two-day visit to Lucknow. At 11 AM, he arrived at Colvin Taluqdars College, the school where he studied. Here, he interacted with 11th and 12th class students on topics such as democracy, elections, and the right to vote. He also toured the school premises. During this, he appeared emotional. He said- Lucknow is not just a city for him, but his workplace. The things this college taught us were very useful to me later in life. That was one era, this is also an era. I told the children that school teachers give a lot of things, one should be receptive to those ideas. Gyanesh Kumar passed his 10th-class examination from Colvin Taluqdars College in 1979 and his 12th-class examination in 1981. He secured the first position in the UP Board both times. The Chief Election Commissioner also spoke to officials from 20 districts and 1500 school students and principals at the Indira Gandhi Pratishthan. He informed the students about the process of becoming a voter, casting a vote, and vote counting. Chief Election Commissioner's 2 major points- 1- The coming generation should be aware of their rights and duties The Chief Election Commissioner told the students, 'Voting is not just a right but a means of participation in building the country's future.' The generation that will become voters in the coming time should be aware of their rights and duties from now on. 2- BLOs play an important role in strengthening democracy The Chief Election Commissioner emphasised transparency in the election process and voter participation. He highlighted the crucial role of Booth Level Officers (BLO). He said they are directly connected to the voters and play a significant role in strengthening the democratic system. Programmes will also be held in all universities and schools in the state to explain the transparency of the election process and the entire procedure. Chief Election Commissioner to interact with 500 BLOs tomorrow The Chief Election Commissioner will interact with about 500 Booth Level Officers (BLOs) from Lucknow and surrounding districts at the Mars Hall of Indira Gandhi Pratishthan. BLOs will share their problems, grounded experiences, and suggestions with him. Issues such as adding new names to the voter list, door-to-door verification, and updating information of deceased or relocated voters will be discussed.

stories.title: Chaos at auction of 243 buffaloes, fistfight breaks out:SP MLA, MP Chandrashekhar’s supporters stage protest; police detain them
stories.summary: In Lucknow, the Municipal Corporation auctioned 243 buffaloes for ₹58,89,000. The auction commenced at 11:00 am on Monday. At around 1:00 pm, workers from the SP Youth Brigade and MP Chandrashekhar's Azad Samaj Party created a commotion. They kicked and punched a youth who had arrived from Sitapur. SP workers alleged that people from outside Lucknow had come for the auction, including several butchers. Seeing the commotion escalate, the police intervened. Shortly after, SP MLA Armaan Khan from the Lucknow West assembly constituency arrived at the spot. He sat on a dharna along with party workers. The police forcibly removed the protesters, carrying them one by one to load them onto a bus, and took them to Eco Garden. MLA Armaan submitted a letter to Additional Municipal Commissioner Dr Arvind Kumar Rao, demanding that the auction be stopped. Several illegal dairies were operating in the Para area. On 16 August, a Municipal Corporation team accompanied by police personnel arrived to clear the encroachments. However, local residents attacked a sub-inspector. Following this, a drive was conducted on 17 and 18 August. A total of 241 female buffaloes, 1 male buffalo, and 1 female calf were seized from the illegal dairies and kept in the Kanji House. The base price for one buffalo was fixed at ₹21,000. To participate in the auction, a deposit of ₹1,02,000 was required.

stories.title: 50 cops in bulletproof jackets raid Kanpur RTO office:22 agents chased and caught, several flee by jumping walls; ₹1 lakh recovered from clerk
stories.summary: A team of district administration officials and 50 police personnel raided the RTO office in Kanpur. Everyone barged inside wearing bulletproof jackets and had both gates of the office shut. Seeing the raid, agents (touts) began running helter-skelter. Illegal vendors outside the RTO closed their shops and fled. The police personnel gave chase and caught 22 touts. However, amid the chaos, several touts managed to escape by scaling the boundary wall. During this, police personnel also got into a scuffle with a lawyer. The team found a shortage of ₹15,000 with Vipin Kumar, a clerk in the Cash Department. Meanwhile, ₹1 lakh in cash was found on challan clerk Mridul Mishra, who failed to account for the money. ADCP Sumit Sudhakar Ramteke interrogated RTO RI (Regional Inspector) Santosh Yadav behind closed doors. Meanwhile, SDM Sadar Anubhav Singh stated that a truck driver had lodged a complaint. The ARTO had issued a challan against him for pollution, a non-functional truck horn, and not wearing a seat belt. He was charged ₹26,700, whereas a receipt for only ₹21,700 was issued to him. Following this, the raid was carried out today (Monday) at around 1:30 PM. During the operation, the police team maintained surveillance using drones. Challan clerk found with ₹1 lakh cash, failed to account for it During the raid, the team from the district administration and the Crime Branch, alongside ARTO Alok Kumar, searched documents in every single department. During this, officials also checked the laptops and computers of officers and employees. After first raiding the Cash Department, the SOG team reached Sarathi Bhawan. Here, they went to Counter No. 6, where biometric processing for vehicle driving licences takes place. Here, they interrogated employee Mujahid Farooqui, a resident of Azamgarh. Mujahid stated that biometric processing could not take place until 12 noon due to the server/website not functioning. Between 12 noon and 3:30 PM, 15 biometrics were completed. SDM states action taken following corruption complaint SDM Anubhav Singh stated that complaints regarding the department had been received for quite some time. Kamta Prasad, a truck driver residing in the Lalpura police station area of Hamirpur district, had lodged a complaint on Saturday (22 August). ARTO Somlata Yadav had issued a challan for his truck on the Bhaunti Bypass. A challan was also issued for not having a seat belt and a heavy driving licence, whereas trucks do not have seat belts. Kamta possessed a heavy driving licence. Despite this, a challan was issued against him. Following this, the district administration formed a team and conducted a raid. After the raid, which lasted for nearly three hours, the police team handed over all 22 touts to the Kakadev police station. The SDM stated that the investigation team inspected the entire RTO premises. During this, essential documents, CCTV footage, and digital recordings were taken into custody. Initial investigation has revealed irregularities in the maintenance of cash. Discrepancies of ₹5,000 to ₹7,000 and other amounts were also found at various locations. All documents and evidence are currently being examined. Once the investigation is complete, the report will be submitted to senior officers. Strict further action will be taken based on this. Truck driver states — ARTO charged ₹26,700, issued receipt for ₹21,700 Truck driver Kamta Prasad stated: “I drive a truck for JK Cement. On Saturday, I was carrying a load of cement from Bharuwa to Mandhana. On the Bhaunti Bypass, ARTO Somlata Yadav issued me a challan of ₹26,750. Non-usage of seat belt in the truck and irregularities regarding a non-functional horn were cited as reasons for the action.” “After paying the challan, I received a receipt for ₹21,700, whereas a payment of ₹26,700 was taken. Upon receiving a receipt for ₹5,000 less, I complained to the officers, but I was turned away. Following this, I lodged a complaint with the district administration,” he said.

stories.title: ‘Possessed by Goddess Kali,’ woman removes husband’s intestines after murder:Victim’s liver and kidney missing
stories.summary: New revelation has emerged in the murder case of Rajesh, a resident of Sitapur, UP, in Kurukshetra, Haryana. Landlord Rinku's mother Amro Devi stated that after the murder, Rajesh's wife Vimla was telling people around- The goddess Kali had possessed me, that's why I killed Rajesh. According to Amro Devi, Vimla jumped from the roof after the incident. When police arrived, she became unconscious. Amro also claimed that Vimla practiced exorcism. Meanwhile, a forensic examination found that half of Rajesh’s liver and one kidney were missing. The incident took place on Saturday when the accused, Vimla, allegedly made a deep incision from Rajesh’s chest to his private parts and stuffed his intestines into a sack. Vimla was Rajesh’s third wife. The couple had a love marriage in Sitapur. Rajesh had divorced his first two wives. About a year ago, he moved from Sitapur to Kurukshetra, where he lived with Vimla in a rented house. The couple had no children. 2 new facts emerge in Rajesh murder case 1. Colleague said, ‘He used to drink alcohol even during the day’ Rajesh worked at PB RO Water Trading Company on Pehowa Road in Kurukshetra, located near his rented house. A colleague, speaking on condition of anonymity, said Rajesh was addicted to alcohol and would sometimes drink even during the day. According to the colleague, Vimala often stopped him from drinking. However, Rajesh never mentioned any quarrel or dispute with his wife. 2. Neighbors saw Vimala eating raw rice and sugar There are only a few houses around the building where Rajesh lived on rent. An empty plot lies on one side, while a garden is on the other. A dharamshala is also located nearby. People in the area were reluctant to speak about the case. One local resident said Vimala mostly stayed inside her room and rarely interacted with neighbors. Some people also claimed they had seen her eating raw rice and sugar several times. Now, know what happened on the day of the incident… Landlord Rinku said that Rajesh lived on the first floor with his wife Vimala. There were frequent quarrels between the husband and wife. On Saturday evening (22 Aug), screaming sounds continued to come from Rajesh and Vimala's room for a long time. Hearing Rajesh's scream, Rinku went upstairs. There Rajesh was lying on the ground drenched in blood. He had a deep wound on his stomach. Vimala was filling his intestines into a plastic sack. Seeing Rinku, Vimala jumped from the roof. Forensic expert said, ‘The wound was 37 cm long’ Forensic expert Dr. Gaurav Kaushik said, “When the body reached them, half of his liver and one kidney were missing. There was a 37-centimeter long and deep incision on the deceased's stomach. The intestines were protruding from the incision.” Dr. Kaushik said that it is the police's responsibility to recover where the deceased's half liver and one kidney are. Woman to be questioned after treatment KUK Police Station In-charge Surendra Sandhu said, After murdering her husband, the accused wife jumped from the roof. This caused injury to her spinal cord. She is admitted in Loknayak Jayprakash Hospital. She will be arrested and interrogated after discharge. Only then will the real reason behind the murder be known.

stories.title: Mosquito bites girl at school, professor father complains to DM:Says, 'School takes full fees, who will be responsible if she falls ill?'
stories.summary: Professor's 6 year old daughter studying in LKG was bitten by a mosquito at school in Moradabad. When the child told her father at home, he complained about the school by emailing DM Dr. Rajendra Painsia. The professor father said, If his daughter falls ill due to the mosquito bite, who will be responsible? Professor Dr. Sonu Singh said, “It is the school's responsibility to provide children with a clean and safe environment. They charge fees. In such a case, the DM should determine the school's accountability in the matter.” Dr. Sonu Singh is an Assistant Professor at Amity University Noida. On 19 August, he complained by sending an email to the DM. Not only this, the professor father said, “He has researched neuropsychology and neurosciences in America for 8 years. Therefore, he understands very well the dangers of diseases caused by mosquitoes.” The case concerns Shirdi Sai Public School on Kanth Road. Complained about mosquito bites earlier, but school took no action The professor said in the complaint, “When my daughter was bitten by a mosquito in school for the first time, this was complained about to the school administration in the school diary. Despite this, no effective action was taken by the school. After this, she was bitten by a mosquito again. That's why we had to complain about the school.” Full fees paid, but school failed to fulfill its responsibility He said, “As parents we leave our children in the trust of the school. We expect that the school will provide them with a safe environment. But even after depositing full fees, the school is not fulfilling its responsibility.” DIOS says – Ordered fogging at school District Magistrate Dr. Rajendra Pensia said, “DIOS has been directed to ensure special attention to cleanliness not only at the concerned school but also at all schools in the district.” DIOS Ritu Tomar said, "I'm aware of the professor’s complaint and has directed the private school to conduct fogging. She added that action will be taken if the instructions are not followed.

stories.title: ED raids former BSP MLA Rana’s premises:Officers arrive in vehicles with ‘Bol Bam’ stickers; searches at 3 locations in Muzaffarnagar
stories.summary: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) conducted raids at three locations linked to former BSP MLA Shahnawaz Rana in Muzaffarnagar on Monday. The ED team arrived around 8 AM in 12 vehicles bearing ‘Bol Bam’ stickers. Around 50 police personnel and CRPF jawans have been deployed, and no one is being allowed to enter or leave the premises. The searches are being conducted at the former MLA’s Rana House on Meerut Road, his newspaper office, and the office of Jammudip Import-Export in Model Town. Rana House also houses the residences of his uncle, former MP Kadir Rana, and former MLA Noor Saleem Rana. The locations being searched include Rana House, the former MLA’s residence on Meerut Road, his newspaper office, and the Jammudip Import-Export office in Model Town. Around 50 police personnel and CRPF jawans have been deployed at all three locations. No one is being allowed to enter or leave the premises, while ED officials are examining documents inside. Rana House also houses the residences of the former MLA’s uncle, former MP Kadir Rana, and former MLA Noor Saleem Rana. Apart from Muzaffarnagar, the ED is conducting searches at six locations in Ghaziabad and Faridabad. According to sources, the action has been taken under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) and is reportedly linked to alleged manipulation of input tax credit and tax evasion. The ED has not yet officially disclosed which documents or materials are being examined. Photos of the ED raids Shahnawaz Rana was jailed over alleges attack on GST team Shahnawaz Rana was arrested on December 5, 2024, for allegedly attacking a GST team that had gone to conduct a raid at the steel factory owned by Rana and his uncle, former MP Kadir Rana. During the same period, a case of alleged fraud involving a fake company was also registered at Civil Lines police station against Kadir Rana’s son, Shah Azam. Both were sent to jail and were initially lodged in Muzaffarnagar Jail, before being shifted to Chitrakoot Jail. In August 2025, Shahnawaz Rana was granted bail by the Allahabad High Court and has remained out of jail since then. The news is being continuously updated...

stories.title: Yogi says Rahul wants to ruin country with urban Naxals:'Look at Ajay Rai’s shamelessness-he bowed before Hanumangarhi, chanted Ram-Ram, then feasted on fish outside'
stories.summary: CM Yogi hit back at Rahul Gandhi over his remarks on Manusmriti In Rae Bareli. He said, “Rahul ji, the country may not expect much from you as Rahul Gandhi, but as the Leader of the Opposition in Parliament, you are accountable to democracy. You should apologise to the country.” Yogi said, After taking the oath of the Constitution, you consider it your birthright to criticise India’s traditions and heritage. You want to ruin the country’s future by placing it in the hands of urban Naxals. Rahul Gandhi had mentioned Manusmriti two days earlier and called the belief that women are the property of their father, husband or children “shameful.” He said a woman’s identity is not defined by her father, husband or son, but by her own identity. He also said women should have complete freedom to pursue education, employment, property ownership and make their own decisions. He said, “Women face violence in three forms: female infanticide, physical abuse and economic restrictions.” Gandhi argued that women should have complete freedom to pursue education, jobs, property ownership and make their own decisions. The CM inaugurated an auditorium built at a cost of ₹21 crore in memory of freedom fighter Rana Beni Madhav Baksh Singh. He was a prominent figure in the 1857 First War of Independence and was also known as ‘Awadh Kesari’. Monday marks his 222nd birth anniversary. See pictures… Yogi targets Ajay Rai over fish feast: “Even a chameleon would feel ashamed” CM Yogi criticised Congress’s UP president Ajay Rai over the fish feast held in Ayodhya. He said Congress leaders were insulting India’s heritage and questioned Rai’s conduct after his visit to Hanumangarhi. Yogi said, They visit Hanumangarhi and then go outside and feast on fish. They chant ‘Ram-Ram’. There should be a limit to shamelessness. If they wanted to eat fish, why did they go to the temple? He added, “Looking at their double standards, even a chameleon would feel ashamed.” Yogi accused Rai of pretending to bow before Bajrangbali at the temple and then attending a fish feast. “Rai bowed before mafia who killed his brother” Targeting Ajay Rai, Yogi alleged that Mukhtar Ansari had killed his brother, but Rai did not speak against him and instead “bowed before” the mafia. He said the BJP government later “crushed that mafia.” Rai visited Hanumangarhi before attending Congress event Ajay Rai had visited Ayodhya on Sunday. He recited the Hanuman Chalisa at Hanumangarhi and then offered prayers at Ram Lalla. Later, he attended a Congress workers’ conference at Tarun Bazar in the Gosaiganj Assembly constituency, around 38 km from Hanumangarhi. A fish feast was organised at the event. 3. Congress does not accept Savarkar, Bose and Sardar Patel CM Yogi said Congress should apologise to the people for repeatedly insulting freedom fighters. He said Veer Savarkar was sentenced to life imprisonment twice in the same lifetime and was only 28 at the time. Both Savarkar brothers were imprisoned in the Cellular Jail, and he could not meet his brother for nearly 10 years. Yogi recalled that Savarkar once saw his brother while being taken to the oil press and realised that he too was imprisoned in the same jail. He also alleged that when the Atal Bihari Vajpayee government named Port Blair Airport after Savarkar, Congress later removed his name. Yogi said Congress also does not accept the contributions of Subhas Chandra Bose and Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. 4. Prime Minister is not an individual, but an institution Yogi said insulting Indian institutions or making derogatory remarks against the Prime Minister amounts to insulting an institution, not merely an individual. He said such actions must be opposed and recalled the “dark shadow” of the 1975 Emergency. He alleged that Congress leaders defame Uttar Pradesh outside the state and insult India when they travel abroad. He also accused them of seeking proof from soldiers fighting enemies at the borders and of directly or indirectly supporting anti-national elements. Yogi further alleged that Congress has questioned the existence of Lord Ram in Ayodhya. 5. ‘The world worships Ayodhya, yet you are questioning it’ CM Yogi said India remains a part of a person wherever they go and highlighted the global respect for Uttar Pradesh and the Awadh region. He said, “If you say you belong to the Awadh region, the whole world is ready to honour you. Yet they are now raising questions about Ayodhya.”

stories.title: ₹40 crore fraud in Gorakhpur:Company lures investors with promise to double money in 400 days; 2,000 people fall victim
stories.summary: A case of fraud worth 40 crores has come to light in Gorakhpur. It is alleged that approximately 2000 people were defrauded by luring them with promises of doubling their deposited amount in 400 days and providing a daily profit of 0.5 percent. Investors from Gorakhpur and Lucknow have accused the company of embezzling their money. It is alleged that the company initially paid interest to investors, but later stopped returning the principal amount by making excuses of company closure and other reasons. The post-dated cheques given to investors are also bouncing due to insufficient funds in the account. Investors have submitted a petition to the SSP for action. Noose tightens around CMD and associates People who fell victim to the fraud mentioned in their petition that the company's CMD and his associates motivated people to invest by providing online IDs and passwords through team leaders from various districts of UP. It was claimed, “The company would give returns at the rate of 0.5 percent per day for 400 days and the deposited amount would double. It was also claimed that a notary affidavit would be provided for securing deposits less than ₹10 lakh and a land agreement for amounts exceeding ₹10 lakh.” Investors allege, "The company paid 0.5% daily returns credited to their accounts until 11 January, 2026. After that, payments were delayed, with the company citing a software update and the CMD’s wife’s wedding as reasons. Investors allege, “The company paid the accrued income in accounts at the rate of 0.5 percent per day until 11 January, 2026. After that, payments started being delayed citing software updates and the CMD's wife's wedding.” In April 2026, investors started demanding their deposited money back. It is alleged that post-dated cheques were issued for the amount to be returned by the company, but the cheques are continuously bouncing due to insufficient funds in the account. Complaint also filed at Ashiana police station in Lucknow Investors said, “They also filed a complaint at Ashiana police station in Lucknow, but no action has been taken yet against the main ringleader of the gang and others, and attempts are being made to suppress the matter.” After that, a complaint has also been filed against the company in Gorakhpur. Investors have demanded from the authorities to get their deposited money back, take action against the accused, and investigate the company's directors.
